364.e: Or that royal sage, wise Rama who always seeks dharma having become one with the supreme spirit has no longer any interest in me?

364.sa: दृश्यमाने भवेत्प्रीति स्सौहृदं नास्त्यपश्यतः।।5.26.43।। नाशयन्ति कृतघ्नास्तु न रामो नाशयिष्यति।
364.e: "Love attaches itself to one who remains before one's eyes.Friendship fades with separation. The ungrateful destroy love and friendship (as their love is conditioned by frequent meetings). But it cannot happen in case of Rama.

364.sa: किं नु मे न गुणाः केचित्किं वा भाग्यक्षयो मम।।5.26.44।।                                                                                                       याहं सीदामि रामेण हीना मुख्येन भामिनी।
364.e: "Do I, a charming lady, not have any good fortune because of my past deeds? I wonder how a foremost woman like me seperated from my husband is sinking in grief without Rama. Has my fortune diminished?

364.sa: श्रेयो मे जीवितान्मर्तुं विहीनाया महात्मनः।।5.26.45।। रामादक्लिष्टचारित्राच्छूराच्छत्रुनिबर्हणात्।
364.e: Instead of living separated from noble and brave Rama, a blemishless character and a destroyer of enemies, it is better for me to die.

364.sa: अथवा न्यस्तशत्रौ तौ वने मूलफलाशिनौ।।5.26.46।। भ्रातरौ हि नरश्रेष्ठौ संवृत्तौ वनगोचरौ।
364.e: "May be both the brothers, foremost among men, have laid down their arms, and taken to asceticism, subsisting on roots and fruits.

364.sa: अथवा राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना।।5.26.47।। छद्मना घातितौ शूरौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।
364.e: "Or else, has this wicked demon king slain both the brothers Rama and Lakshmana by some deceptive means?

364.sa: साऽहमेवङ्गते काले मर्तुमिच्छामि सर्वथा।।5.26.48।। न च मे विहितो मृत्युरस्मिन् दुःखेऽपि वर्तते।
364.e: "By all means I wish to die in these circumstances. However, death is not ordained for me even in this sorrowful state.

364.sa: धन्याः खलु महात्मानो मुनयस्त्यक्तकिल्बिषाः।।5.26.49।। जितात्मनो महाभागा येषां न स्तः प्रियाप्रिये।
364.e: Blessed are the exhalted sages who have not committed any sin. They have self control and have subdued their senses. There is no pleasure or displeasure for them.

364.sa: प्रियान्न संभवेद्दुःखमप्रियादधिकं भयम्।।5.26.50।। ताभ्यां हि ये वियुज्यन्ते नमस्तेषां महात्मनाम्।
364.e: "Salutations to those exalted souls who have distanced themselves from pleasure and displeasure. Pleasures may not lead to suffering or displeasure to excessive, meaningless fear for such great souls.

364.sa: साहं त्यक्ता प्रियार्हेण रामेण विदितात्मना।।5.26.51।। प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यामि पापस्य रावणस्य गता वशम्।
364.e: "Separated from the wise Rama who deserves pleasant things I will give up life being under the clutches of the sinful Ravana. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षडिवंश स्सर्गः। Thus ends the twentysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

365.sa: इत्युक्तास्सीतया घोरं राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः। काश्चिज्जग्मुस्तदाख्यातुं रावणस्य तरस्विनः।।5.27.1।।
365.e: Hearing Sita's words, some terrifying demonesses, overwhelmed with anger, went to inform Ravana, who was quick to act.

365.sa: ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यो घोरदर्शनाः। पुनः परुषमेकार्थमनर्थार्थमथाब्रुवन्।।5.27.2।।
365.e: The dreadfullooking demonesses once again approached Sita and conveyed her categorically in harsh words the terrible consequences (ahead)

365.sa: अद्येदानीं तवानार्ये सीते पापविनिश्चये। राक्षस्यो भक्षयिष्यन्ति मांसमेतद्यथासुखम्।।5.27.3।।
365.e: "O vile one you are determined in your evil ways. Today these shedemons will eat away your flesh to their heart's content ".

365.sa: सीतां ताभिरनार्याभिर्दृष्टवा सन्तर्जितां तदा। राक्षसी त्रिजटा वृद्धा शयाना वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।5.27.4।।
365.e: Then seeing the ignoble shedemons threatening Sita, an old demoness called Trijata, who was lying down there, said:

365.sa: आत्मानं खादतानार्या न सीतां भक्षयिष्यथ। जनकस्य सुतामिष्टां स्नुषां दशरथस्य च।।5.27.5।।
365.e: "Devour yourselves now, O ignoble ones, if you will. Do not eat Janaka's favourite daughter, the daughterinlaw of Dasaratha.

365.sa: स्वप्नो ह्यद्य मया दृष्टो दारुणो रोमहर्षणः। राक्षसानामभावाय भर्तुरस्या भवाय च।।5.27.6।।
365.e: "Tonight I had a terrific, horriplating nightmare in which I saw the annihilation of all demons and the triumph of Sita's husband".

365.sa: एवमुक्तास्त्रिजटया राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः। सर्वा एवाब्रुवन्भीतास्त्रिजटां तामिदं वचः।।5.27.7।।
365.e: Seized with fear, the shedemons, overcome with wrath on hearing Trijata's words said to her.

365.sa: कथयस्व त्वया दृष्टः स्वप्नोऽयं कीदृशो निशि। तासां श्रुत्वा तु वचनं राक्षसीनां मुखाच्युतम्।।5.27.8।। उवच वचनं काले त्रिजटा स्वप्नसंश्रितम्।
365.e: "O Trijata, tell us the kind of dream you dreamt last night", they insisted. Hearing the words from the mouth of the shedemons, Trijata told them all about her dream.

365.sa: गजदन्तमयीं दिव्यां शिबिकामन्तरिक्षगाम्।।5.27.9।। युक्तां हंससहस्रेण स्वयमास्थाय राघवः। शुक्लमाल्याम्बरधरो लक्ष्मणेन सहागतः।।5.27.10।।
365.e: "Rama, in white attire, wearing a garland of white flowers, ascending a palanquin made of ivory drawn by a thousand swans and coursing through the sky with Lakshmana arrived.

365.sa: गजदन्तमयीं दिव्यां शिबिकामन्तरिक्षगाम्।।5.27.9।। युक्तां हंससहस्रेण स्वयमास्थाय राघवः। शुक्लमाल्याम्बरधरो लक्ष्मणेन सहागतः।।5.27.10।।
365.e: "Rama, in white attire, wearing a garland of white flowers, ascending a palanquin made of ivory drawn by a thousand swans and coursing through the sky with Lakshmana arrived.

365.sa: स्वप्ने चाद्य मया दृष्टा सीता शुक्लाम्बरावृता। सागरेण परिक्षिप्तं श्वेतं पर्वतमास्थिता।।5.27.11।।
365.e: "I also saw Sita in my dream wearing white robes and perched on a white mountain surrounded by the ocean.

365.sa: रामेण सङ्गता सीता भास्करेण प्रभा यथा। राघवश्च मया दृष्टश्चतुर्दष्ट्रं महागजम्।।5.27.12।। आरूढ श्शैलसङ्काशं चचार सहलक्ष्मणः।
365.e: "Just as light is united with the Sun, I saw Sita united with Rama. I saw Rama with Lakshmana riding a huge, mountainlike elephant having four tusks.

365.sa: ततस्तौ नरशार्दूलौ दीप्यमानौ स्वतेजसा।।5.27.13।। शुक्लमाल्याम्बरधरौ जानकीं पर्युपस्थितौ।
365.e: "Dressed in white garlands and clothes, the two brothers, tigers among men, glowing in their effulgence approached Janaki.

365.sa: ततस्तस्य नगस्याग्रे ह्याकाशस्थस्य दन्तिनः।।5.27.14।। भर्त्रा परिगृहीतस्य जानकी स्कन्धमाश्रिता।
365.e: "Then from the front of the mountain Janaki shifted to the back of the elephant held by her husband waiting in the sky.

365.sa: भर्तुरङ्कात्समुत्पत्य ततः कमललोचना।।5.27.15।। चन्द्रसूर्यौ मया दृष्टा पाणिना परिमार्जती।
365.e: "Then I saw the lotuseyed Sita springing up from the lap of her husband and playfully caressing the Moon and Sun with her palms.

365.sa: ततस्ताभ्यां कुमाराभ्यामास्थित: स गजोत्तमः।।5.27.16।। सीतया च विशालाक्ष्या लङ्काया उपरिस्थितः।
365.e: "Then the excellent elephant was seen halted in the city of Lanka with both princes and the largeeyed Sita mounted on the elephant.

365.sa: पाण्डुरर्षभयुक्तेन रथेनाष्टयुजा स्वयम्।।5.27.17।। इहोपयातः काकुत्स्थ स्सीतया सह भार्यया।
365.e: "Rama accompanied by his wife Sita came on a chariot yoked to eight white oxen.

365.sa: लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया सह वीर्यवान्।।5.27.18।। आरुह्य पुष्पकं दिव्यं विमानं सूर्यसन्निभम्। उत्तरां दिशमालोक्य जगाम पुरुषोत्तमः।।5.27.19।।
365.e: "Valiant Rama, foremost among men, accompanied by his brother Lakshmana and wife Sita went towards the northerly direction in the wonderful Pushpaka chariot that resembled the Sun.

365.sa: लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया सह वीर्यवान्।।5.27.18।। आरुह्य पुष्पकं दिव्यं विमानं सूर्यसन्निभम्। उत्तरां दिशमालोक्य जगाम पुरुषोत्तमः।।5.27.19।।
365.e: "Valiant Rama, foremost among men, accompanied by his brother Lakshmana and wife Sita went towards the northerly direction in the wonderful Pushpaka chariot that resembled the Sun.

365.sa: एवं स्वप्ने मया दृष्टो रामो विष्णुपराक्रमः। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया सह राघवः।।5.27.20।।
365.e: "In this way I saw in my dream Rama as valiant as Lord Visnu accompanied by his brother Lakshmana and his wife Sita.

365.sa: न हि रामो महातेजाश्शक्यो जेतुं सुरासुरैः। राक्षसैर्वापि चान्यैर्वा स्वर्गः पापजनैरिव।।5.27.21।।
365.e: "Just as a sinner cannot attain heaven Rama cannot be won by gods or demons, even rakshasas and others.

365.sa: रावणश्च मया दृष्टः क्षितौ तैलसमुक्षितः। रक्तवासाः पिबन्मत्तः करवीरकृतस्रजः।।5.27.22।।
365.e: "I saw the body of Ravana lying on the ground smeared with oil, clad in red, wearing a garland of lilies and intoxicated with drinking.

365.sa: विमानात्पुष्पकादद्य रावणः पतितो भुवि। कृष्यमाणः स्त्रिया दृष्टो मुण्डः कृष्णाम्बरः पुनः।।5.27.23।।
365.e: "Tonight I saw (in another dream) Ravana with shaven head, clad in black clothes, fallen down on the ground from the Pushpaka chariot, being dragged by a woman.

365.sa: रथेन खरयुक्तेन रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनः। पिपंस्तैलं हसन्नृत्यन् भ्रान्तचित्ताकुलेन्द्रियः।।5.27.24।।
365.e: "He was wearing red garlands and unguents, his body smeared with oil. He was drinking, laughing and dancing, his mind and senses perplexed. He was driving on a chariot yoked to donkeys.

365.sa: गर्दभेन ययौ शीघ्रं दक्षिणां दिशमास्थितः। पुनरेव मया दृष्टो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः।।5.27.25।। पतितोऽ वाक्चिरा रा भूमौ गर्दभाद्भयमोहितः।
365.e: "I saw the demon king Ravana running behind the chariot driven by donkeys in the southerly direction. He was falling with his head bent down and deluded by the fear of the donkey.

365.sa: सहसोत्थाय संभ्रान्तो भयार्तो मदविह्वलः।।5.27.26।। उन्मत्त इव दिग्वासा दुर्वाक्यं प्रलपन्बहु। दुर्गन्धं दुस्सहं घोरं तिमिरं नरकोपमम्।।5.27.27।। मलपङ्कं प्रविश्याशु मग्नस्तत्र स रावणः।
365.e: "I saw Ravana, getting up quickly, in a bewildered state, terrorstricken, totally confused in intoxication. He had gone almost insane, naked uttering words of abuse. Plunged into a pool of filth and emitting foul smell he disappeared into a helllike dark chamber.

365.sa: सहसोत्थाय संभ्रान्तो भयार्तो मदविह्वलः।।5.27.26।। उन्मत्त इव दिग्वासा दुर्वाक्यं प्रलपन्बहु। दुर्गन्धं दुस्सहं घोरं तिमिरं नरकोपमम्।।5.27.27।। मलपङ्कं प्रविश्याशु मग्नस्तत्र स रावणः।
365.e: "I saw Ravana, getting up quickly, in a bewildered state, terrorstricken, totally confused in intoxication. He had gone almost insane, naked uttering words of abuse. Plunged into a pool of filth and emitting foul smell he disappeared into a helllike dark chamber.

365.sa: कण्ठे बद्ध्वा दशग्रीवं प्रमदा रक्तवासिनी।।5.27.28।। काली कर्दमलिप्ताङ्गी दिशं याम्यां प्रकर्षति।
365.e: A dark woman clad in red, body smeared with wet mud was seen dragging the ten-necked Ravana by his neck towards the abode of Yama in the southerly direction.

365.sa: एवं तत्र मया दृष्टः कुम्भकर्णो निशाचरः।।5.27.29।। रावणस्य सुतास्सर्वे दृष्टास्तैलसमुक्षिताः।
365.e: "There I saw the nightranger, Kumbhakarna and also Ravana's sons, their bodies smeared with oil.

365.sa: वराहेण दशग्रीवश्शिंशुमारेण चेन्द्रजित्।।5.27.30।। उष्ट्रेण कुम्भकर्णश्च प्रयाता दक्षिणां दिशम्।
365.e: "The tennecked Ravana was seen (this time) riding on a boar, Indrajit on a crocodile and Kumbhakarna on a camel all set towards the southerly direction.

365.sa: एकस्तत्र मया दृष्टः श्वेतच्छत्रो विभीषणः।।5.27.31।। शुक्लमाल्याम्बरधरः शुक्लगन्धानुलेपनः।
365.e: "Only Vibhishana was under a white umbrella clad in white, with white garlands and white sandal paste.

365.sa: शङ्खदुन्धुभिनिर्घोषैर्नृत्तगीतैरलङ्कृतः।।5.27.32।। आरुह्य शैलसङ्काशं मेघस्तनितनिस्स्वनम्। चतुर्दन्तं गजं दिव्यमास्ते तत्र विभीषणः।।5.27.33।। चतुर्भिस्सचिवैः सार्थं वैहायसमुपस्थितः।
365.e: "(Hailed by) the sounds of conches and drums, and of musicians and dancers, Vibhishana was seen ascending on to a decorated fourtust elephant which was huge like a mountain and trumpting like a thundering cloud. He stood there along with four ministers and reached the aerial region.

365.sa: शङ्खदुन्धुभिनिर्घोषैर्नृत्तगीतैरलङ्कृतः।।5.27.32।। आरुह्य शैलसङ्काशं मेघस्तनितनिस्स्वनम्। चतुर्दन्तं गजं दिव्यमास्ते तत्र विभीषणः।।5.27.33।। चतुर्भिस्सचिवैः सार्थं वैहायसमुपस्थितः।
365.e: "(Hailed by) the sounds of conches and drums, and of musicians and dancers, Vibhishana was seen ascending on to a decorated fourtust elephant which was huge like a mountain and trumpting like a thundering cloud. He stood there along with four ministers and reached the aerial region.

365.sa: समाजश्च मया दृष्टो गीतवादित्रनिःस्वनः।।5.27.34।। पिबतां रक्तमाल्यानां रक्षसां रक्तवाससाम्।
365.e: " A large group of demons was seen collected together, drinking, wearing red garlands and red clothes, singing and playing musical instruments.

365.sa: लङ्का चेयं पुरी रम्या सवाजिरथकुञ्जराः।।5.27.35।। सागरे पतिता दृष्टा भग्नगोपुरतोरणा।
365.e: "I saw this delightful Lanka teeming with horses, chariots and elephants, archways and towers crumbling and falling into the ocean.

365.sa: लङ्का दृष्टा मया स्वप्ने रावणेनाभिरक्षिता।।5.27.36।। दग्धा रामस्य दूतेन वानरेण तरस्विना।
365.e: In my dream I saw this city of Lanka protected by Ravana burnt down by a powerful vanara , a messenger of Rama.

365.sa: पीत्वा तैलं प्रनृत्ताश्च प्रहसन्त्यो महास्वनाः।।5.27.37।। लङ्कायां भस्मरूक्षायां सर्वा राक्षसस्त्रियः।
365.e: "All the demonesses in the city of Lanka which had turned dry, reduced to ashes, were dancing, laughing and shouting loudly drunk with oil..

365.sa: कुम्भकर्णादयश्चेमे सर्वे राक्षसपुङ्गवाः।।5.27.38।। रक्तं निवसनं गृह्य प्रविष्टा गोमयह्रदे।
365.e: "Kumbhakarna and other demon leaders wearing red clothes entered into a pool of cow dung.

365.sa: अपगच्छत नश्यध्वं सीतामाप्नोति राघवः।।5.27.39।। घातयेत्परमामर्षी युष्मान्सार्थं हि राक्षसैः।
365.e: "(Therefore) go away from here. You will be totally destroyed by Rama who will secure his wife and will kill  all of you along with others in great anger.

365.sa: प्रियां बहुमतां भार्यां वनवासमनुव्रताम्।।5.27.40।। भर्त्सितां तर्जितां वापि नानुमंस्यति राघवः।
365.e: "Rama will not approve of any one abusing or threatening his venerable, beloved wife, who had led a life of exile with him.

365.sa: तदलं क्रूरवाक्यैश्च सान्त्वमेवाभिधीयताम्।।5.27.41।। अभियाचाम वैदेहीमेतद्धि मम रोचते।
365.e: "Give up these cruel taunts. Speak to her in a cordial manner. We will beg Vaidehi's forgiveness. I like this kind of action.

365.sa: यस्यामेवंविधः स्वप्नो दुःखितायां प्रदृश्यते।।5.27.42।। सा दुःखैर्विविधैर्मुक्ता प्रियं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्।
365.e: "When any demoness in a sorrowful state dreams this kind of dream, she will be relieved of sorrow and will obtain supreme joy.

365.sa: भर्त्सितामपि याचध्वं राक्षस्यः किं विवक्षया।।5.27.43।। राघवाद्धि भयं घोरं राक्षसानामुपस्थितम्।
365.e: "O demonesses beg her (pardon) now even though you had threatened her earlier. Where is the need to hesitate? There is cause for concern for demons from Rama.

365.sa: प्रणिपातप्रसन्ना हि मैथिली जनकात्मजा।।5.27.44।। अलमेषा परित्रातुं राक्षस्यो महतो भयात्।
365.e: "O shedemons, this Janaka's daughter from Mithila who is capable of protecting you against great dangers will be pleased by your submission.

365.sa: अपि चास्या विशालाक्ष्या न किंचिदुपलक्षये।।5.27.45।। विरूपमपि चाङ्गेषु सुसूक्ष्ममपि लक्षणम्।
365.e: "Look at the signs on her body. There is not a little inauspiciousness in the limbs of the largeeyed princess from Mithila.

365.sa: छायावैगुण्यमात्रं तु शङ्के दुःखमुपस्थितम्।।5.27.46।। अदुःखार्हामिमां देवीं वैहायसमुपस्थिताम्।
365.e: A great suffering has befallen a lady who does not deserve to suffer. Therefore, a change in her complexion has occured.

365.sa: अर्थसिद्धिं तु वैदेह्याः पश्याम्यहमुपस्थिताम्।।5.27.47।। राक्षसेन्द्रविनाशं च विजयं राघवस्य च।
365.e: "I see the day of fulfilment for Vaidehi has drawn near. I can also foresee the destruction of the demon king and the triumph of Rama.

365.sa: निमित्तभूतमेतत्तु श्रोतुमस्या महत्प्रियम्।।5.27.48।। दृश्यते च स्फुरच्चक्षुः पद्मपत्रमिवायतम्।
365.e: "This dream indeed served as an augery for good news about her. Look, her (left) eye which is large like a lotus petal is throbbing.

365.sa: ईषच्छ हृषितो वास्या दक्षिणाया ह्यदक्षिणः।।5.27.49।। अकस्मादेव वैदेह्या बाहुरेकः प्रकम्पते।
365.e: "The left shoulder of this great Vaidehi has started suddenly throbbing, indicating that she is feeling a bit happy.

365.sa: करेणुहस्तप्रतिम स्सव्यश्चोरुरनुत्तमः।।5.27.50।। वेपमानः सूचयति राघवं पुरतः स्थितम्।
365.e: "Her excellent left thigh, comparable to a female elephant's trunk is trembling, as though indicating that Rama is standing in her presence.

365.sa: पक्षी च शाखानिलयं प्रविष्टः पुनः पुनश्चोत्तमसान्त्ववादी। सुस्वागतां वाचमुदीरयानः पुनः पुनश्चोदयतीव हृष्टः।।5.27.51।।
365.e: "One can see the bird which utters excellent sweet notes indicating happy tidings, entering again and again the foliage of the tree, a delightful bird, as if prompting Sita again and again to rejoice. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तविंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the twentyseventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

366.sa: सा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वचो निशम्य तद्रावणस्याप्रियमप्रियार्ता। सीता वितत्रास यथा वनान्ते सिंहाभिपन्ना गजराजकन्या।।5.28.1।।
366.e: After hearing the unpleasant words spoken by the king of demons, which caused restlessness and sorrow to Sita, she was terrified like the young calf of a lordly elephant fallen into the clutches of a lion in the midst of the forest.

366.sa: सा राक्षसीमध्यगता च भीरु र्वाग्भिर्भृशं रावणतर्जिता च। कान्तारमध्ये विजने विसृष्टा बालेव कन्या विललाप सीता।।5.28.2।।
366.e: Encircled by the demonesses, Sita was repeatedly humiliated by Ravana's cruel words.She wept like a young girl deserted in a desolate forest.

366.sa: सत्यं बतेदं प्रवदन्ति लोके नाकालमृत्युर्भवतीति सन्तः। यत्राहमेवं परिभर्त्स्यमाना जीवामि दीना क्षणमप्यपुण्या।।5.28.3।।
366.e: "Even though I am threatened like this, I am living pitiably because of lack of merit. Indeed I regret my survival due to my bad luck. Elders say that death will not ocurr before its time. It seems to be true.

366.sa: सुखाद्विहीनं बहुदुःखपूर्ण मिदं तु नूनं हृदयं स्थिरं मे। विशीर्यते यन्न सहस्रधाऽद्य वज्राहतं शृङ्गमिवाचलस्य।।5.28.4।।
366.e: "Even though I am devoid of joy, and living in deep agony, my heart bursts not into a thousand pieces like the summit of a mountain hit by thunderbolt (lightning).

366.sa: नैवास्ति दोषो मम नूनमत्र वध्याहमस्याप्रियदर्शनस्य। भावं न चास्याहमनुप्रदातु मलं द्विजो मन्त्रमिवाद्विजाय।।5.28.5।।
366.e: "I will not be blamed if I commit suicide now.I stand condemned to death in the hands of this ugly Ravana. I cannot bestow my affection on him or surender to his desire like a brahmin would not like to impart Vedic knowledge to a nonbrahmin. (Better die of my own accord than be killed by a sinful ogre).

366.sa: नूनं ममाङ्गान्यचिरादनार्यः शस्त्रैश्शितैश्छेत्स्यति राक्षसेन्द्रः। तस्मिननागच्छति लोकनाथे गर्भस्थजन्तोरिव शल्यकृन्तः।।5.28.6।।
366.e: "If the lord of the world does not come here before that (time fixed by Ravana) the vile lord of demons will cut me into pieces with weapons just as a barber would cut to pieces the foetus with a sharp knife (in order to save a pregnant woman).

366.sa: दुःखं बतेदं मम दुःखिताया मासौ चिरायाधिगमिष्यतो द्वौ। बद्धस्य वध्यस्य तथा निशान्ते राजापराधादिव तस्करस्य।।5.28.7।।
366.e: "Alas, two months is too long a time to wait in grief. I am like a thief captured for offending a king and waiting overnight for execution at day-break.

366.sa: हा राम हा लक्ष्मण हा सुमित्रे हा राममातः सह मे जनन्या। एषा विपद्याम्यहमल्पभाग्या महार्णवे नौरिव मूढवाता।।5.28.8।।
366.e: "Alas! Rama, Alas! Lakshmana, Alas! Sumitra, Alas! my mother, Alas! Rama's mother, I am an ill-starred woman going to perish in this way like a light boat capsized in the midst of an ocean when the whirl-wind blows.

366.sa: तरस्विनौ धारयता मृगस्य सत्त्वेन रूपं मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रौ। नूनं विशस्तौ मम कारणात्तौ सिंहर्षभौ द्वाविव वैद्युतेन।।5.28.9।।
366.e: "Just like two mighty lions are killed by a bolt of lightning, the two princes must have been killed by a creature in the guise of a deer on my account.

366.sa: नूनं स कालो मृगरूपधारी मामल्पभाग्यां लुलुभे तदानीम्। यत्रार्यपुत्रं विससर्ज मूढा रामानुजं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजं च।।5.28.10।।
366.e: "Verily, it is the spirit of the time that assumed the form of deer and tempted this unfortunate soul. It was foolish of me to send away, the sons of a noble king, Lakshmana and his elder brother.

366.sa: हा राम सत्यव्रत दीर्घबाहो हा पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमानवक्त्र। हा जीवलोकस्य हितः प्रियश्च वध्यां न मां वेत्सि हि राक्षसानाम्।।5.28.11।।
366.e: "Alas, O long-armed one unfailing in vows, whose face shines like the full moon. Alas, beloved of all the worlds! you are dear to every one. How is it that you are not aware that I am going to be killed by the demons?

366.sa: अनन्य दैवत्वमियं क्षमा च भूमौ च शय्या नियमश्च धर्मे। पतिव्रतात्वं विफलं ममेदं कृतं कृतघ्नेष्विव मानुषाणाम्।।5.28.12।।
366.e: "I am devoted to you and to no other god. My hardship in sleeping on the ground, my righteousness, my discipline and chastity have all proved futile like the devotion of an ungrateful person.

366.sa: मोघो हि धर्मश्चरितो मयायं तथैकपत्नीत्वामिदं निरर्थम्। या त्वां न पश्यामि कृशा विवर्णा हीना त्वया सङ्गमने निराशा।।5.28.13।।
366.e: "This righteousnes practised by me is in vain like my devotion to you, as I am unable to see you. I am a separated, emaciated, pale with no hope of reuniting with you.

366.sa: पितुर्निदेशं नियमेन कृत्वा  वनान्निवृत्तश्चरितव्रतश्च। स्त्रीभिस्तु मन्ये विपुलेक्षणाभिस्त्वं रंस्यसे वीतभयः कृतार्थः।।5.28.14।।
366.e: "Having truly fulfilled your pledge given to your father, you will return from the forest to Ayodhya, rid of all fear, as an accomplished person, will and revel in the company of largeeyed damsels, I think.

366.sa: अहं तु राम त्वयि जातकामा चिरं विनाशाय निबद्धभावा। मोघं चरित्वाथ तपो व्रतञ्च त्यक्ष्यामि धिग्जीवितमल्पभाग्याम्।।5.28.15।।
366.e: "O RamaI loved you and concentrated all my love on you for a long time only for my doom. I have observed vows and austerities in vain. I cannot continue it for long. Here I am giving up my life. Fie upon this luckless one (me).

366.sa: सा जीवितं क्षिप्रमहं त्यजेयं विषेण शस्त्रेण शितेन वापि। विषस्य दाता न हि मेऽस्ति कश्चि च्छस्त्रस्य वा वेश्मनि राक्षसस्य।।5.28.16।।
366.e: "I will end my life at once by taking poison or else by a sharp weapon. Alas There is none to give get me poison or a weapon at this demon's residence".

366.sa: इतीव देवी बहुधा विलप्य सर्वात्मना राममनुस्मरन्ती। प्रवेपमाना परिशुष्कवक्त्रा नगोत्तमं पुष्पितमाससाद।।5.28.17।।
366.e: Queen Sita was wailing in many ways, constantly remembering Rama, the soul of all. Shivering, her face pales as she approached the great Simsupa tree in bloom.

366.sa: सा शोकतप्ता बहुधा विचिन्त्य सीताऽथ वेण्युद्ग्रथनं गृहीत्वा। उद्बुध्य वेण्युद्ग्रथनेन शीघ्रमहं गमिष्यामि यमस्य मूलम्।।5.28.18।।
366.e: "Burning in grief, worrying in many ways, Sita took hold of her braid and said", by tying myself with this braid I shall quickly reach the presence of the lord of death".

366.sa: उपस्थिता सा मृदुसर्वगात्री शाखां गृहत्वाऽध नगस्य तस्य। तस्यास्तु रामं प्रविचिन्तयन्त्या रामानुजं स्वं च कुलं शुभाङ्ग्या:।।5.28.19।। शेकानिमित्तानि तथा बहूनि धैर्यार्जितानि प्रवराणि लोके। प्रादुर्निमित्तानि तदा बभूवुः पुरापि सिद्धान्युपलक्षितानि।।5.28.20।।
366.e: Sita of delicate limbs approached the Simsupa tree and held on to a branch and stood. While she was thinking of Rama and Lakshmana and their noble family many  omens of proven results appeared on her auspicious charming body. These omens were dispellers of grief, and harbingers of courage in the world as declared from ancient times. (Now) they manifested themselves. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyeigth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

367.sa: तथागतां तां व्यथितामनिन्दितां व्यपेतहर्षां परिदीनमानसाम्। शुभां निमित्तानि शुभानि भेजिरे नरं श्रिया जुष्टमिवोपजीविनः।।5.29.1।।
367.e: Like wellwishers flocking round a person on whom fortune is smiling, omens foretelling auspicious happenings in near future appeared to Sita. She was unimpeachable. She was in agony, distressed in mind, bereft of all joy (now) standing under that Simsupa tree.

367.sa: तस्याः शुभं वाममरालपक्ष्म राजीवृतं कृष्णविशालशुक्लम्। प्रास्पन्दतैकं नयनं सुकेश्या मीनाहतं पद्ममिवाभिताम्रम्।।5.29.2।।
367.e: Her left eye with a row of curved eyelashes, the black pupils of the eye in white throbbed in an auspicious manner. The lady  with her long tresses, and throbbing eye appeared like a red lotus gently struck by a fish.

367.sa: भुजश्च चार्वञ्चितपीनवृत्तः परार्थ्यकालागरुचन्दनार्हः। अनुत्तमेनाध्युषितः प्रियेण चिरेण वामः समवेपताऽशु।।5.29.3।।
367.e: Her stout left arm curved beautifully, fit for excellent agaru and sandal paste once the pillow by her beloved lord for long, throbbed suddenly.

367.sa: गजेन्द्रहस्तप्रतिमश्च पीन स्तयोर्द्वयोः सम्हतयोः सुजातः। प्रस्पन्दमानः पुनरूरुरस्या रामं पुरस्तात् स्थितमाचचक्षे।।5.29.4।।
367.e: Again her roundshaped left thigh resembling an elephant's trunk started throbbing, presaging union with Rama.

367.sa: शुभं पुनर्हेमसमानवर्ण मीषद्रजोध्वस्तमिवामलाक्ष्याः। वास स्स्थिताया श्शिखराग्रदन्त्याः किञ्चित्परिस्रंसत चारुगात्य्राः।।5.29.5।।
367.e: Her eyes were pristine, teeth wellshaped. The goldhued auspicious sari on her charming limbs was now a little soiled on account of dust. It slipped slightly as she stood up. This augured well for her.

367.sa: एतैर्निमित्तैरपरैश्च सुभ्रूः सम्बोधिता प्रागपि साधु सिद्धैः। वातातपक्लान्तमिव प्रणष्टं वर्षेण बीजं प्रतिसंजहर्ष।।5.29.6।।
367.e: Reassured by such omens which augured well as tested by time, Sita, with beautiful eyebrows, and deep foresight experienced great joy, like a seed blighted by the wind and the Sun comes back to joyful life through a pleasing shower. (A foreteller is addressed as siddha in sanskrit dramas)

367.sa: तस्याः पुनर्बिम्बफलाधरोष्ठं स्वक्षिभ्रुकेशान्तमरालपक्ष्म। वक्त्रं बभासे सितशुक्लदंष्ट्रं राहोर्मुखाच्चन्द्र इव प्रमुक्तः।।5.29.7।।
367.e: Her face shining with beautiful red lips like bimba fruit, sparkling teeth, and curved eyelashes with lovely brows extending up to her hair, she appeared like a Moon released from the mouth of Rahu.

367.sa: सा वीतशोका व्यपनीततन्द्री शान्तज्वरा हर्षविबुद्धसत्त्वा। अशोभतार्या वदनेन शुक्ले शीतांशुना रात्रिरिवोदितेन।।5.29.8।।
367.e: Revered Sita, completely relieved of grief, exhaustion gone, fears allayed, mind illumined with joy, looked charming with her countenance as a night with the Moon fully risen during the bright fortnight. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic compsed by sage Valmiki.

368.sa: हनुमानपि विक्रान्तः सर्वं शुश्राव तत्त्वतः। सीतायास्त्रिजटायाश्च राक्षसीनां च तर्जनम्।।5.30.1।।
368.e: The valiant hero Hanuman heard everything including the lamentation of Sita and the dream of Trijata and the threats of the demonesses.

368.sa: अवेक्षमाणस्तां देवीं देवतामिव नन्दने। ततो बहुविधां चिन्तां चिन्तयामास वानरः।।5.30.2।।
368.e: The sight of Sita who seemed a deity in the Nandana garden of Indra, set a chain of reflections in his mind :

368.sa: यां कपीनां सहस्राणि सुबहून्ययुतानि च। दिक्षु सर्वासु मार्गन्ते सेयमासादिता मया।।5.30.3।।
368.e: "This is Sita whom thousands of vanaras are searching in all directions.

368.sa: चारेण तु सुयुक्तेन शत्रोश्शक्तिमवेक्षता। गूढेन चरता तावदवेक्षितमिदं मया।।5.30.4।।
368.e: "Roaming everywhere incognito to ascertain carefully the strength of the enemy, I have seen everything.

368.sa: राक्षसानां विशेषश्च पुरी चेयमवेक्षिता। राक्षसाधिपतेरस्य प्रभावो रावणस्य च।।5.30.5।।
368.e: "I have seen the ability of the demons and the citadel of Lanka. I have seen the power of Ravana the demon king.

368.sa: युक्तं तस्याप्रमेयस्य सर्वसत्त्वदयावतः। समाश्वासयितुं भार्यां पतिदर्शनकाङ्क्षिणीम्।।5.30.6।।
368.e: "It is the opportune time for me to comfort Sita eagerly waiting to see her husband who is of immeasurable prowess and who is compassionate to all beings.

368.sa: अहमाश्वासयाम्येनां पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्। अदृष्टदुःखां दुःखार्तां दुःखस्यान्तमगच्छतीम्।।5.30.7।।
368.e: "The moonfaced Sita had never experienced sorrow before. She sees no end to her sorrow and suffering. I will console her.

368.sa: यद्यप्यहमिमां देवीं शोकोपहतचेतनाम्। अनाश्वास्य गमिष्यामि दोषवद्गमनं भवेत्।।5.30.8।।
368.e: "If I should return to Kishkindha without reassuring Sita, whose understanding has been clouded in grief I would be blamed.

368.sa: गते हि मयि तत्रेयं राजपुत्री यशस्विनी। परित्राणमविन्दन्ती जानकी जीवितं त्यजेत्।।5.30.9।।
368.e: "If I so back, this illustrious princess, Janaki will give up her life, finding no means of deliverance (from this tragic situation).

368.sa: मया च स महाबाहुः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननः। समाश्यासयितुं न्याय्यस्सीतादर्शनलालसः।।5.30.10।।
368.e: "I should provide some comfort to the strongarmed Rama with a face like the fullmoon yearning to see Sita.

368.sa: निशाचरीणां प्रत्यक्षमनर्हं चाभिभाषितम्। कथन्नु खलु कर्तव्यमिदं कृच्छ्रगतो ह्यहम्।।5.30.11।।
368.e: "I cannot talk to her in the presence of these nightroamers. How can I  discharge my duty in this predicament?

368.sa: अनेन रात्रिशेषेण यदि नाश्वास्यते मया। सर्वथा नास्ति सन्देहः परित्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्।।5.30.12।।
368.e: "If I do not comfort her before the remaining part of the night ends, she will give up her life. There is no doubt about it.

368.sa: रामश्च यदि पृच्छेन्मां किं मां सीताब्रवीद्वचः। किमहं तं प्रति ब्रूयामसंभाष्य सुमध्यमाम्।।5.30.13।।
368.e: "If Rama enquires about the message of Sita, this lady of beautiful waist, what can I speak without meeting and talking to her?

368.sa: सीतासन्देशरहितं मामितस्त्वरयाऽगतम्। निर्दहेदपि काकुत्स्य क्रुद्धस्तीव्रेण चक्षुषा।।5.30.14।।
368.e: "If I leave this place without any message from Sita, Rama will burn me with his eyes full of great anger.

368.sa: यदि चोद्योजयिष्यामि भर्तारं रामकारणात्। व्यर्थमागमनं तस्य ससैन्यस्य भविष्यति।।5.30.15।।
368.e: "If I get the lord of vanaras and his army for the cause of Rama (without talking to Sita), their arrival will be useless (if Sita would have given up her life by then).

368.sa: अन्तरं त्वहमासाद्य राक्षसीनामिह स्थितः। शनैराश्वासयिष्यामि सन्तापबहुळामिमाम्।।5.30.16।।
368.e: "I shall wait and speak to her slowly and console this deeply distressed lady when I get a chance to speak to her (when  these ogresses are asleep).

368.sa: अहं त्वतितनुश्चैव वानरश्च विशेषतः। वाचं चोदाहरिष्यामि मानुषीमिह संस्कृताम्।।5.30.17।।
368.e: I am indeed of small size and that too a monkey. Nevertheless I shall speak in Sanskrit, a language of the common people. (as the she-demons cannot understand that language).

368.sa: यदि वाचं प्रदास्यामि द्विजातिरिव संस्कृताम्। रावणं मन्यमाना मां सीता भीता भविष्यति।।5.30.18।। वानरस्य विशेषेण कथं स्यादभिभाषणम्।
368.e: "If I speak like a brahmin in sanskrit language she would be frightened thinking that I am Ravana and how would a vanara speak?

368.sa: अवश्यमेव वक्तव्यं मानुषं वाक्यमर्थवत्।।5.30.19।। मया सान्त्वयितुं शक्या नान्यथेयमनिन्दिता।
368.e: "I will certainly speak to her meaningfully in the language of the people. Otherwise it is not possible to pacify the sinless Sita.

368.sa: सेयमालोक्य मे रूपं जानकी भाषितं तथा।।5.30.20।। रक्षोभिस्त्रासिता पूर्वं भूयस्त्रासं गमिष्यति।
368.e: "Since Janaki has already been frightened by the demons, she will be even more terrified seeing me in this form and hearing me speaking this way.

368.sa: ततो जातपरित्रासा शब्दं कुर्यान्मनस्विनी।।5.30.21।। जानमाना  विशालाक्षी रावणं कामरूपिणम्।
368.e: By seeing me in this form, sensitive largeeyed Sita will scream loudly thinking that I am Ravana who can assume any form at his free will.

368.sa: सीतया च कृते शब्दे सहसा राक्षसीगणा:। नानाप्रहरणो घोर: समेयादन्तकोपम:।।5.30.22।।
368.e: "If Sita screams, the  horde of terrific ogresses will at once gather, armed with dreadful weapons like Yama, the god of death.

368.sa: ततो मां सम्परिक्षिप्य सर्वतो विकृताननाः।।5.30.23।। वधे च ग्रहणे चैव कुर्युर्यत्नं यथाबलम्।
368.e: "Then all these hideous ogresses will swarm round me and make efforts to capture me with all their strength and kill me.

368.sa: गृह्य शाखाः प्रशाखाश्च स्कन्धांश्चोत्तमशाखिनाम्।।5.30.24।। दृष्ट्वा विपरिधावन्तं भवेयुर्भयशङ्किताः।
368.e: "Seeing me holding big and small branches of large trees and leaping from one place to the other, the ogresses will get scared.

368.sa: मम रूपं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य वने विचरतो महत्।।5.30.25।। राक्षस्यो भयवित्रस्ता भवेयुर्विकृताननाः।
368.e: "These ogresses with their hideous faces will be frightened on looking at my huge form moving in this grove.

368.sa: ततः कुर्युस्समाह्वानं राक्षस्यो रक्षसामपि।।5.30.26।। राक्षसेन्द्रनियुक्तानां राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशने।
368.e: "Thereafter the ogresses will draw the attention of demon guards engaged by the king of demons at his residence towards me.

368.sa: ते शूलशक्तिनिस्त्रिंशविविधायुधपाणयः।।5.30.27।। आपतेयुर्विमर्देऽस्मिन्वेगेनोद्वेगकारणात्।
368.e: "Those ogresses due to fear will come speedily, armed with spears, tridents, swords and different kinds of weapons for a combat.

368.sa: समृद्धस्तैस्तु परितो विधमन् रक्षसां बलम्।।5.30.28।। शक्नुयां न तु संप्राप्तुं परं पारं महोदधेः।
368.e: "With them around me, I may not be able to  reach the other end of the ocean (my strength spent in the combat.)

368.sa: मां वा गृह्णीयुराप्लुत्य बहवश्शीघ्रकारिणः।।5.30.29।। स्यादियं चागृहीतार्था मम च ग्रहणं भवेत्।
368.e: "The ogres who are in large numbers, here are very prompt to act. They will jump into the sky and bind me. Sita will not receive the message and I will be taken into custody by the demons.

368.sa: हिंसाभिरुचयो हिंस्युरिमां वा जनकात्मजाम्।।5.30.30।। विपन्नं स्यात्ततः कार्यं रामसुग्रीवयोरिदम्।
368.e: "These demons who are keen on indulging in violence will harm Janaka's daughter. Then the mission of Rama and Sugriva will also fail.

368.sa: उद्देशे नष्टमार्गेऽस्मिन् राक्षसैः परिवारिते।।5.30.31।। सागरेण परिक्षिप्ते गुप्ते वसति जानकी।
368.e: "Janaki is staying in this untraceable location surrounded by demons. And this location is a secret place surrounded by the ocean .

368.sa: विशस्ते वा गृहीते वा रक्षोभिर्मयि संयुगे।।5.30.32।। नान्यं पश्यामि रामस्य सहायं कार्यसाधने।
368.e: "If I am killed in the combat or captured by the demons, I do not see another person who can help in accomplishing this task.

368.sa: विमृशंश्च न पश्यामि यो हते मयि वानरः।।5.30.33।। शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं लङ्घयेत महोदधिम्।
368.e: "When I am killed here, I cannot see any other vanara who can leap over a hundred yojanas of the ocean (to reach this place).

368.sa: कामं हन्तुं समर्थोऽस्मि सहस्राण्यपि रक्षसाम्।।5.30.34।। न तु शक्ष्यामि सम्प्राप्तुं परं पारं महोदधेः।
368.e: "I may be capable of killing even thousands of demons but thereafter (thoroughly exhausted) reach the other side of the ocean.

368.sa: असत्यानि च युद्धानि संशयो मे न रोचते।।5.30.35।। कश्च निस्संशयं कार्यं कुर्यात्प्राज्ञः ससंशयम्।
368.e: "Battles, no doubt, are unpredictable. Which wise man with a sound intellect will take up a doubtful work unhesitatingly?

368.sa: प्राणत्यागश्च वैदेह्या भवेदनभिभाषणे।।5.30.36।। एष दोषो महान्हि स्यान्मम सीताभिभाषणे।
368.e: "If I talk to Vaidehi it will be a great mistake on my part.If I do not speak to Vaidehi she may give up her life.

368.sa: भूताश्चार्था विनश्यन्ति देशकालविरोधिताः।।5.30.37।। विक्लबं दूतमासाद्य तमः सूर्योदये यथा।
368.e: "Even well planned diplomatic missions fail like darkness dispelled at Sunrise if the messenger is confused and if the place and time are not propitious for them.

368.sa: अर्थानर्थान्तरे बुद्धिनिश्चितापि न शोभते।।5.30.38।। घातयन्ति हि कार्याणि दूताः पण्डितमानिनः।
368.e: "Swinging from a course of action or an action leading to calamity is not proper. Messengers who assume that they are scholars (blinded by ego) destroy their mission.

368.sa: न विनश्येत्कथं कार्यं वैक्लब्यं न कथं भवेत्।।5.30.39।। लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य कथं नु न वृथा भवेत्।
368.e: "How can the mission succeed? How can failure of mission be avoided? How can the crossing of the great ocean be not wasted?"

368.sa: कथं नु खलु वाक्यं मे शृणुयान्नोद्विजेत वा। इति सञ्चिन्त्य हनुमांश्चकार मतिमान्मतिम्।।5.30.40।।
368.e: Wise Hanuman came to a decision after reflecting in his mind about how not to create fear in Sita (while communicating with her.)

368.sa: राममक्लिष्टकर्माणं सुबन्धुमनुकीर्तयन्।।5.30.41।। नैनामुद्वेजयिष्यामि तद्बन्धुगतमानसाम्।
368.e: "By praising Rama who is very dear, who is judicious in action and in whom her mind is absorbed, I will not create fear.

368.sa: इक्ष्वाकूणां वरिष्ठस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः।।5.30.42।। शुभानि धर्मयुक्तानि वचनानि समर्पयन्। श्रावयिष्यामि सर्वाणि मधुरां प्रब्रुवन् गिरम्।।5.30.43।। श्रद्धास्यति यथाहीयं तथा सर्वं समादधे।
368.e: "I shall present in auspicious words the esteemed Rama of Ikshvaku family who is a knower of self and make her listen to everything in such a sweet manner that she will trust me.

368.sa: इक्ष्वाकूणां वरिष्ठस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः।।5.30.42।। शुभानि धर्मयुक्तानि वचनानि समर्पयन्। श्रावयिष्यामि सर्वाणि मधुरां प्रब्रुवन् गिरम्।।5.30.43।। श्रद्धास्यति यथाहीयं तथा सर्वं समादधे।
368.e: "I shall present in auspicious words the esteemed Rama of Ikshvaku family who is a knower of self and make her listen to everything in such a sweet manner that she will trust me.

368.sa: इति स बहुविधं महानुभावो जगतिपतेः प्रमदामवेक्षमाणः। मधुरमवितथं जगाद वाक्यं द्रुमविटपान्तरमास्थितो हनूमान्।।5.30.44।।
368.e: Highsouled Hanuman seated on the branch of the tree without being seen began to speak faithfully in praise of the lord of the universe in many ways while looking at her. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

369.sa: एवं बहुविधां चिन्तां चिन्तयित्वा महाकपिः। संश्रवे मधुरं वाक्यं वैदेह्या व्याजहार ह।।5.31.1।।
369.e: After deliberating in several ways the great Hanuman spoke these sweet words to Vaidehi:

369.sa: राजा दशरथो नाम रथकुञ्जरवाजिमान्। पुण्यशीलो महाकीर्तिरिक्ष्वाकूणां महायशाः।।5.31.2।।
369.e: "There was an illustrious king called Dasaratha in Ikshvaku race, a master of chariots, elephants and horses. He was highly meritorious and renowned.

369.sa: राजर्षीणां गुणश्रेष्ठस्तपसा चर्षिभि स्समः। चक्रवर्तिकुले जातः पुरन्दरसमो बले।।5.31.3।।
369.e: "He was the most virtuous among royal sages, equal to sages in austerity, born in the race of emperors and equal to Indra in might.

369.sa: अहिंसारतिरक्षुद्रो घृणी सत्यपराक्रमः। मुख्यश्चेक्ष्वाकुवंशस्य लक्ष्मीवान् लक्ष्मिवर्धनः।।5.31.4।।
369.e: "He was committed to nonviolence, magnanimous, compassionate and one whose strength was truth. He was not only a prosperous king of Ikshvaku family but also a promoter of prosperity of others too.

369.sa: पार्थिवव्यञ्जनैर्युक्तः पृथुश्रीः पार्थिवर्षभः। पृथिव्यां चतुरन्तायां विश्रुतस्सुखदस्सुखी।।5.31.5।।
369.e: "Endowed with signs of kingship and vast wealth, he was a bull among rulers of the vast earth, surrounded by the sea. A happy king himself, he was wellknown as a provider of happiness.

369.sa: तस्य पुत्रः प्रियो ज्येष्ठस्ताराधिपनिभाननः। रामो नाम विशेषज्ञः श्रेष्ठ स्सर्वधनुष्मताम्।।5.31.6।।
369.e: "His beloved eldest son Rama, whose countenance is like the full moon, is a scholar of all branches of knowledge and is foremost among the bowmen on earth.

369.sa: रक्षिता स्वस्य धर्मस्य स्वजनस्य च रक्षिता। रक्षिता जीवलोकस्य धर्मस्य च परन्तपः।।5.31.7।।
369.e: "The scourage of enemies, he is a protector of righteousness and of his kins and all living creatures. He is an embodiment of righteousness.

369.sa: तस्य सत्याभिसन्धस्य वृद्धस्य वचनात्पितुः। सभार्यस्सह च भ्रात्रा वीरः प्रव्राजितो वनम्।।5.31.8।।
369.e: "Honouring the word of his aged father who was ever steadfast in truth, Rama left for the forest along with his wife and brother.

369.sa: तेन तत्र महारण्ये मृगयां परिधावता। राक्षसा निहताश्शूरा बहवः कामरूपिणः।।5.31.9।।
369.e: "In the deep forest he went round hunting animals and killing the demon warriors who assumed any form at their free will.

369.sa: जनस्थानवधं श्रुत्वा हतौ च खरदूषणौ। ततस्त्वमर्षापहृता जानकी रावणेन तु।।5.31.10।। वञ्चयित्वा वने रामं मृगरूपेण मायया।
369.e: "Ravana having heard about the killing of all demons at Janasthana including Khara and Dooshana in the forest, deceived Rama in the guise of a deer and abducted Janaki in anger.

369.sa: स मार्गमाणस्तां देवीं रामस्सीतामनिन्दिताम्।।5.31.11।। आससाद वने मित्रं सुग्रीवं नाम वानरम्।
369.e: "While looking for the goddesslike lady, the sinless Sita in the forest, Rama met a monkey called Sugriva and made friendship with him

369.sa: तत स्स वालिनं हत्वा रामः परपुरञ्जयः।।5.31.12।। प्रायच्छत्कपिराज्यं तत्सुग्रीवाय महाबलः।
369.e: "Rama, a powerful king, who can win enemy forts killed Vali and offered the monkey kingdom to Sugriva.

369.sa: सुग्रीवेणापि सन्दिष्टा हरयः कामरूपिणः।।5.31.13।। दिक्षु सर्वासु तां देवीं विचिन्वन्ति सहस्रशः।
369.e: "Having received Sugriva's orders thousands of monkeys who can assume any form went searching for that divine queen in all directions.

369.sa: अहं सम्पातिवचनाच्छतयोजनमायतम्।।5.31.14।। अस्या हेतोर्विशालाक्ष्याः सागरं वेगवान्प्लुतः।
369.e: "On hearing the words of Sampati I leaped the wide ocean swiftly crossing a hundred yojanas in quest of the largeeyed Sita.

369.sa: यथारूपां यथावर्णां यथालक्ष्मीवतीं च निश्चिताम्।।5.31.15।। अश्रौषं राघवस्याहं सेयमासादिता मया।
369.e: "Surely I have seen here a lady of similar body, of similar complexion, of similar glow and beauty as described by Rama".

369.sa: विररामैवमुक्त्वासौ वाचं वानरपुङ्गवः।।5.31.16।। जानकी चापि तच्छ्रुत्वा परं विस्मयमागता।
369.e: Having spoken thus, the great vanara stopped speaking after that. Janaki was wonderstruck by the words of the vanara.

369.sa: ततस्सा वक्रकेशान्ता सुकेशी केशसंवृतम्।।5.31.17।। उन्नम्य वदनं भीरुश्शिंशुपावृक्षमैक्षत।
369.e: Then Sita looked up at the Simsupa tree timidly, her face covered with beautiful curly hair.

369.sa: निशम्य सीता वचनं कपेश्च दिशश्च सर्वाः प्रदिशश्च वीक्ष्य। स्वयं प्रहर्षं परमं जगाम सर्वात्मना राममनुस्मरन्ती ।।5.31.18।।
369.e: On hearing Hanuman's words Sita looked at all directions and quarters while quietly contemplating on Rama, the self of all and experienced supreme joy.

369.sa: सा तिर्यगूर्ध्वं च तथाप्यधस्तान्निरीक्षमाणा तमचिन्त्यबुद्धिम्। ददर्श पिङ्गाधिपतेरमात्यं वातात्मजं सूर्यमिवोदयस्थम्।।5.31.19।।
369.e: She looked obliquely, up, and down and saw Hanuman of unimaginable intelligence, the minister of the monkey lord, son of the Windgod, who looked like the rising Sun. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

370.sa: ततश्शाखान्तरे लीनं दृष्ट्वा चलितमानसा। वेष्टितार्जुनवस्त्रं तं विद्युत्सङ्घातपिङ्गलम्।।5.32.1।।
370.e: Sita got perplexed on seeing him (Hanuman), who was tawny in complexion and looked like a cluster of lightnings, clad in white  and hidden in between the branches.

370.sa: सा ददर्श कपिं तत्र प्रश्रितं प्रियवादिनम्। फुल्लाशोकोत्कराभासं तप्तचामीकरेक्षणम्।।5.32.2।।
370.e: There (on the tree) she noticed a monkey like a cluster of fully blossomed Ashoka flower, shining bright, whose eyes were glowing like pure molten gold, speaking softly and pleasingly.

370.sa: मैथिली चिन्तयामास विस्मयं परमं गता। अहो भीममिदं रूपं वानरस्य दुरासदम्।।5.32.3।। दुर्निरीक्षमिति ज्ञात्वा पुनरेव मुमोह सा।
370.e: Astonisted Mythili began thinking. 'Oh this vanara's appearance is frightening. He is terrible to look at. He is inaccessible'. Thinking over this again and again, she fainted.

370.sa: विललाप भृशं सीता करुणं भयमोहिता।।5.32.4।। रामरामेति दुःखार्ता लक्ष्मणेति च भामिनी। रुरोद बहुधा सीता मन्दं मन्दस्वरा सती।।5.32.5।।
370.e: Overcome with sorrow and fear, noble Sita sobbed pitiably muttering repeatedly. 'O Rama, O Rama, O Lakshmana'.

370.sa: विललाप भृशं सीता करुणं भयमोहिता।।5.32.4।। रामरामेति दुःखार्ता लक्ष्मणेति च भामिनी। रुरोद बहुधा सीता मन्दं मन्दस्वरा सती।।5.32.5।।
370.e: Overcome with sorrow and fear, noble Sita sobbed pitiably muttering repeatedly. 'O Rama, O Rama, O Lakshmana'.

370.sa: सा तं दृष्ट्वा हरिश्रेष्ठं विनीतवदुपस्थितम्। मैथिली चिन्तयामास स्वप्नोऽयमिति भामिनी।।5.32.6।।
370.e: Noble Sita, seeing the best of vanaras who stood near humbly, began reflecting 'Is this a dream'?

370.sa: सा वीक्षमाणा पृथुभुग्नवक्त्रं शाखामृगेन्द्रस्य यथोक्तकारम्। ददर्श पिङ्गाधिपते रमात्यं वातात्मजं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम्।।5.32.7।।
370.e: Looking here and there, she saw a monkey with a large, curved face, an obedient servant and a minister of the monkeylord, the foremost among the intelligentia and the son of the Windgod.

370.sa: सा तं समीक्ष्यैव भृशं विसंज्ञा गतासुकल्पेन बभूव सीता। चिरेण संज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य भूयो विचिन्तयामास विशालनेत्रा।।5.32.8।।
370.e: The largeeyed Sita lost her senses looking at him. She got back her senses after a long time and started thinking again:

370.sa: स्वप्ने मयाऽयं विकृतोऽद्य दृष्टश्शाखामृगश्शास्त्रगणैर्निषिद्धः। स्वस्त्यस्तु रामाय स लक्ष्मणाय तथा पितुर्मे जनकस्य राज्ञः।।5.32.9।।
370.e: 'Today I saw an ugly monkey in my dream. Its sight in a dream is inauspicious according to sastras. Let it be auspicious for Lakshmana and Rama for the sake of my father Janaka.

370.sa: स्वप्नोऽपि नायं नहि मेऽस्ति निद्रा शोकेन दुःखेन च पीडितायाः। सुखं हि मे नास्ति यतोऽस्मि हीना तेनेन्दुपूर्णप्रतिमाननेन।।5.32.10।।
370.e: "But no, it was not a dream for tormented by grief and sorrow I cannot have a dream. When separated from the moonfaced Rama I have no sleep or pleasure, how can I have dream?

370.sa: रामेति रामेति सदैव बुद्ध्या विचिन्त्य वाचा ब्रुवती तमेव। तस्यानुरूपां च कथां तदर्थमेवं प्रपश्यामि तथा शृणोमि।।5.32.11।।
370.e: "I am always meditating upon Rama and thinking of him alone. I am talking about things related to him. Because of that I see him and hear him.

370.sa: अहं हि तस्याद्य मनोभवेन सम्पीडिता तद्गतसर्वभावा। विचिन्तयन्ती सततं तमेव तथैव पश्यामि तथा शृणोमि।।5.32.12।।
370.e: "I am tormented by intense love for Rama, with all my thoughts immersed in him. Since I am constantly thinking of him I see him and hear words about him. (She thinks it is all hallucination.)

370.sa: मनोरथस्स्यादिति चिन्तयामि तथापि बुद्ध्या च वितर्कयामि। किं कारणं तस्य हि नास्ति रूपं सुव्यक्तरूपश्च वदत्ययं माम्।।5.32.13।।
370.e: "I feel it is only the desire in my mind. Desire has no form. But the one who is addressing me has a form. I cannot understand this.

370.sa: नमोऽस्तु वाचस्पतये सवज्रिणे स्वयंभुवे चैव हुताशनाय च। अनेन चोक्तं यदिदं ममाग्रतो वनौकसा तच्छ तथास्तु नान्यथा।।5.32.14।।
370.e: "My salutations to Indra, Brihaspati, Brahma the creator and also to the firegod. Let all those words spoken by the vanara here in front of me be true and not other than that." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्वात्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysecond sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

371.sa: सोऽवतीर्य द्रुमात्तस्माद्विद्रुमप्रतिमाननः। विनीतवेषः कृपणः प्रणिपत्योपसृत्य च।।5.33.1।। तामब्रवीन्महातेजा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय सीतां मधुरया गिरा।।5.33.2।।
371.e: Hanuman, son of the Windgod whose face shone like coral, dressed in a sober manner climbed down the tree, went close to Sita, offered salutations with his palms on his head and spoke in sweet words:

371.sa: सोऽवतीर्य द्रुमात्तस्माद्विद्रुमप्रतिमाननः। विनीतवेषः कृपणः प्रणिपत्योपसृत्य च।।5.33.1।। तामब्रवीन्महातेजा हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः। शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय सीतां मधुरया गिरा।।5.33.2।।
371.e: Hanuman, son of the Windgod whose face shone like coral, dressed in a sober manner climbed down the tree, went close to Sita, offered salutations with his palms on his head and spoke in sweet words:

371.sa: का नु पद्मपलाशाक्षि क्लिष्टकौशेयवासिनि। द्रुमस्य शाखामालम्ब्य तिष्ठसि त्वमनिन्दिते।।5.33.3।।
371.e: "O blameless lady with eyes like lotus petals, in crumpled silk, holding a branch, and standing, who are you?

371.sa: किमर्थम् तव नेत्राभ्यां वारि स्रवति शोकजम्। पुण्डरीकपलाशाभ्यां विप्रकीर्णमिवोदकम्।।5.33.4।।
371.e: "Why are tears of grief flowing from your eyes like water trickling down a pair of petals of white lotuses?

371.sa: सुराणामसुराणां वा नागगन्धर्वरक्षसाम्। यक्षाणां किन्नराणां वा का त्वं भवसि शोभने।।5.33.5।।
371.e: "O noble lady, are you a goddess or a demoness, a naga, a gandharva, a rakshasa, a yaksha or a kinnera?

371.sa: का त्वं भवसि रुद्राणां मरुतां वा वरानने। वसूनां हि वरारोहे देवता प्रतिभासि मे।।5.33.6।।
371.e: "O beautiful lady Do you belong to the race of Rudras, or Marutas, or Vasus?. O noble lady, you appear a goddess to me.

371.sa: कि नु चन्द्रमसा हीना पतिता विबुधालयात्। रोहिणी ज्योतिषां श्रेष्ठा श्रेष्ठसर्वगुणान्विता।।5.33.7।।
371.e: "are you Rohini, embellished with best virtues among the constellations? Have you come down from the abode of the luminaries separated from the Moon, her lord?

371.sa: का त्वं भवसि कल्याणि त्वमनिन्दितलोचने। कोपाद्वा यदि वा मोहाद्भर्तारमसितेक्षणे।।5.33.8।। वसिष्ठं कोपयित्वा त्वं नासि कल्याण्यरुन्धती।
371.e: "O lady of lovely black eyes who are you? Have you by any chance offended your husband out of anger or out of delusion? Are you the auspicious Arundhati dislodged for making your lord Vasistha angry?

371.sa: को नु पुत्रः पिता भ्राता भर्ता वा ते सुमध्यमे।।5.33.9।। अस्माल्लोकादमुं लोकं गतं त्वमनुशोचसि।
371.e: "O woman of beautiful waist from which world have you come here? For whom are you worrying? Who is your son, father, brother or husband? Are you worrying about some one dead?.

371.sa: रोदनादतिनिश्श्वासाद्भूमिसंस्पर्शनादपि।।5.33.10।। न त्वां देवीमहं मन्ये राज्ञ स्सर्वज्ञावधारणात्।
371.e: "From your weeping, your sighing and your touching the earth (gods do not touch the earth) and your signs of sovereignty, I do not think you are a goddess (meaning otherwise she posessed divine grace).

371.sa: व्यञ्जनानि च ते यानि लक्षणानि च लक्षये।।5.33.11।। महिषी भूमिपालस्य राजकन्या च मे मता।
371.e: "On the basis of your royal signs and other qualities I infer that you are the daughter of a king or his consort.

371.sa: रावणेन जनस्थानाद्बलादपदहृता यदि।।5.33.12।। सीता त्वमसि भद्रं ते तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः।
371.e: "If you are Sita, who was forcefully borne away by Ravana from Janasthana you may kindly reveal to me freely. May god bless you.

371.sa: यथा हि तव वै दैन्यं रूपं चाप्यतिमानुषम्।।5.33.13।। तपसा चान्वितो वेषस्त्वं राममहिषी ध्रुवम्।
371.e: "Indeed your plight, the superhuman beauty and your robes marked with asceticism, surely tell me that you are Rama's queen."

371.sa: सा तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा रामकीर्तनहर्षिता।।5.33.14।। उवाच वाक्यं वैदेही हनुमन्तं द्रुमाश्रितम्।
371.e: Happy to have heard words of praise of Rama, Vaidehi spoke this to Hanuman, who got up the tree:

371.sa: पृथिव्यां राजसिंहानां मुख्यस्य विदितात्मनः।।5.33.15।। स्नुषा दशरथस्याहं शत्रुसैन्यप्रतापिनः।
371.e: "I am daughterinlaw of king Dasaratha, knower of the self, the foremost among kings on earth and a slayer of enemy army.

371.sa: दुहिता जनकस्याहं वैदेहस्य महात्मनः।।5.33.16।। सीतेति नाम नाम्नाऽहं भार्या रामस्य धीमतः।
371.e: "I am daughter of the great soul, Janaka, king of Videha, known as Sita. I am the wife of that sagacious Rama.

371.sa: समा द्वादश तत्राहं राघवस्य निवेशने।।5.33.17।। भुञ्जाना मानुषान्भोगान्सर्वकामसमृद्धिनी।
371.e: "I enjoyed worldly pleasures in abundance for twelve years at Rama's abode.

371.sa: तत्र त्रयोदशे वर्षे राज्येनेक्ष्वाकुनन्दनम्।।5.33.18।। अभिषेचयितुं राजा सोपाध्यायः प्रचक्रमे।
371.e: "Then in the thirteenth year king Dasaratha along with the royal preceptor arranged to  coronate Rama, delight of the Ikshvaku family, in the kingdom.

371.sa: तस्मिन्सम्भ्रियमाणे तु राघवस्याभिषेचने।।5.33.19।। कैकयी नाम भर्तारं देवी वचनमब्रवीत्।
371.e: "While preparations for the coronation were on, queen Kaikeyi said to her husband:

371.sa: न पिबेयं न खादेयं प्रत्यहं मम भोजनम्।।5.33.20।। एष मे जीवितस्यान्तो रामो यद्यभिषिच्यते।
371.e: 'I shall not drink or eat food, if Rama is coronated. I shall end my life this moment.

371.sa: यत्तदुक्तं त्वया वाक्यं प्रीत्या नृपतिसत्तम।।5.33.21।। तच्छेन्न वितथं कार्यं वनं गच्छतु राघवः।
371.e: 'O Dasaratha, the foremost among kings if the promise lovingly made by you earlier is not going to be false, Rama should go to the forest'.

371.sa: स राजा सत्यवाग्देव्या वरदानमनुस्मरन्।।5.33.22।। मुमोह वचनं श्रुत्वा कैकेय्याः क्रूरमप्रियम्।
371.e: "Remembering the boons the ever truthful king had granted to Kaikeyi, he fainted after hearing her cruel and harsh words.

371.sa: ततस्तु स्थविरो राजा सत्ये धर्मे व्यवस्थितः।।5.33.23।। ज्येष्ठं यशस्विनं पुत्रं रुदन्राज्यमयाचत।
371.e: "The aged king who held on to truthfulness and righteousness begged his famed eldest son Rama to return the kingdom.

371.sa: स पितुर्वचनं श्रीमानभिषेकात्परं प्रियम्।।5.33.24।। मनसा पूर्वमासाद्य वाचा प्रतिगृहीतवान्।
371.e: "The illustrious Rama who valued his father's word more than sovereignty, bowed to the command of the father.

371.sa: दद्यान्न प्रतिगृह्णीयान्न ब्रूयात्किञ्चिदप्रियम्।।5.33.25।। अपि जीवितहेतोर्वा रामस्सत्यपराक्रमः।
371.e: "Rama, whose strength was his truthfulness, gave whatever others sought but would not accept anything in return. He would not speak a harsh word.

371.sa: स विहायोत्तरीयाणि महार्हाणि महायशाः।।5.33.26।। विसृज्य मनसा राज्यं जनन्यै मां समादिशत्।
371.e: "Having given up the kingdom  voluntarily, Rama, a highly renowned king cast off his luxurious upper garments and asked me to take care of his mother.

371.sa: साहं तस्याग्रतस्तूर्णं प्रस्थिता वनचारिणी।।5.33.27।। न हि मे तेन हीनाया वासस्स्वर्गेऽपि रोचते।
371.e: "I, however resolved to live in the forest, marched ahead of him quickly as I did not prefer even heaven without him.

371.sa: प्रागेव तु महाभागस्सौमित्रिर्मित्रनन्दनः।।5.33.28।। पूर्वजस्यानुयात्रार्थे द्रुमचीरैरलङ्कृतः।
ते वयं भर्तुरादेशं बहुमान्य दृढव्रताः।।5.33.29।। प्रविष्टास्स्म पुरादृष्टं वनं गम्भीरदर्शनम्।
371.e: "Respecting the king's order and determined firmly, we entered the impenetrable forest.

371.sa: वसतो दण्डकारण्ये तस्याहममितौजसः।।5.33.30।। रक्षसाऽपहृता भार्या रावणेन दुरात्मना।
371.e: "While the most valiant Rama was living in the Dandaka forest, I, his wife was borne away by the evilminded Ravana.

371.sa: द्वौ मासौ तेन मे कालो जीवितानुग्रहः कृतः।।5.33.31।। ऊर्ध्वं द्वाभ्यां तु मासाभ्यां ततस्तक्ष्यामि जीवितम्।
371.e: "He has allowed me two months time to live. After two months I will have to give up my life." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtythird sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

372.sa: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान्हरिपुङ्गवः। दुःखाद्दुःखाभिभूताया स्सान्त्वमुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.34.1।।
372.e: Hearing the words of Sita who was overwhelmed with grief, the monkey leader Hanuman felt sad and thus spoke comforting her:

372.sa: अहं रामस्य सन्देशाद्देवि दूतस्तवागतः। वैदेहि कुशली रामस्त्वां च कौशलमब्रवीत्।।5.34.2।।
372.e: "By the command of Rama I am here as a messenger. He is keeping well. He is well and wishes you well.

372.sa: यो ब्रह्ममस्त्रं वेदांश्च वेद वेदविदांवरः। स त्वां दाशरथी रामो देवि कौशलमब्रवीत्।।5.34.3।।
372.e: "O godlike lady Rama, son of Dasaratha, master of the Vedas, wielder of Brahmastra wishes you well.

372.sa: लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजा भर्तुस्तेऽनुचरः प्रियः। कृतवान्शोकसन्तप्तश्शिरसा तेऽभिवादनम्।।5.34.4।।
372.e: "The mighty Lakshmana too, a dear brother and follower of your husband is immersed in grief, and sends salutations to you."

372.sa: सा तयोः कुशलं देवी निशम्य नरसिंहयोः। प्रीतिसंहृष्टसर्वाङ्गी हनुमन्तमथाब्रवीत्।।5.34.5।।
372.e: On hearing the wellbeing of Rama and Lakshman, lions among men, Sita experienced thrill all over her body. She then  spoke to Hanuman:

372.sa: कल्याणी बत गाथेयं लौकिकी प्रतिभाति मा। एति जीवन्तमानन्दो नरं वर्षशतादपि।।5.34.6।।
372.e: "The adage that 'joy comes to a living being even though it be at the end of  a hundred years' is popular. It appears true in my case".

372.sa: तया समागते तस्मिन्प्रीतिरुत्पादिताऽद्भुता। परस्परेण चालापं विश्वस्तौ तौ प्रचक्रतुः।।5.34.7।।
372.e: Hanuman thus created a sense of wonderful joy in her as they came together. Both of them started to converse restoring confidence in each other.

372.sa: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान्हरियूथपः। सीतायाश्शोकदीनायास्समीपमुपचक्रमे।।5.34.8।।
372.e: Hearing the reply of Sita, who was crying piteously, stricken with grief, the monkey leader, Hanuman moved close to her.

372.sa: यथा यथा समीपं स हनुमानुपसर्पति। तथा तथा रावणं सा तं सीता परिशङ्कते।।5.34.9।।
372.e: As Hanuman started slowly drawing close, Sita suspected he might be Ravana.

372.sa: अहो धिग्दुष्कृतमिदं कथितं हि यदस्य मे। रूपान्तरमुपागम्य स एवायं हि रावणः।।5.34.10।।
372.e: "Ohshame on me. I have told him my story which should not have been said. This is verily Ravana come in a disguise".

372.sa: तामशोकस्य शाखां सा विमुक्त्वा शोककर्शिता। तस्यामेवानवद्याङ्गी धरण्यां समुपाविशत्।।5.34.11।।
372.e: So saying Sita of flawless limbs, emaciated with grief, left the branch of Ashoka tree held by her and squatted on the ground.

372.sa: हनुमानपि दुःखार्तां तां दृष्ट्वा भयमोहिताम्। अवन्दत महाबाहुस्ततस्तां जनकात्मजाम्।।5.34.12।। सा चैनं भयवित्रस्ता भूयो नैवाभ्युदैक्षत।
372.e: The longarmed Hanuman saw Sita, who was stricken with grief and deluded with fear. He prostrated to her. But out of fear she did not look at him.

372.sa: तं दृष्ट्वा वन्दमानं तु सीता शशिनिभानना।।5.34.13।। अब्रवीद्धीर्घमुच्छवस्य वानरं मधुरस्वरा।
372.e: On seeing the vanara prostrated, the moonfaced lady, sighed deeply and spoke to him in a sweet voice:

372.sa: मायां प्रविष्टो मायावी यदि त्वं रावणस्स्वयम्।।5.34.14।। उत्पादयसि मे भूयस्सन्तापं तन्न शोभनम्।
372.e: "If you are that trickster Ravana who appears incognito before me, it is not good for you. You are causing grief again.

372.sa: स्वं परित्यज्य रूपं यः परिव्राजकरूपध्रुत्। जनस्थाने मया दृष्टस्त्वं स एवासि रावणः।।5.34.15।।
372.e: "You are the same Ravana who took the guise of a mendicant, giving up your real form and came to Janasthana.

372.sa: उपवासकृशां दीनां कामरूप निशाचर। सन्तापयसि मां भूयस्सन्तप्तां तन्न शोभनम्।।5.34.16।।
372.e: "Oh you are one who can assume any form at will. You are a nightstalker. It is not good for you to cause pain to me who is already emaciated through fasting, who is pitiable and who is already afflicted.

372.sa: अथवा नैतदेवं हि यन्मया परिशङ्कितम्।।5.34.17।। मनसो हि मम प्रीतिरुत्पन्ना तव दर्शनात्।
372.e: "May be my suspicion is not correct Because I am experiencing pleasure in my mind in your presence.

372.sa: यदि रामस्य दूतस्त्वमागतो भद्रमस्तु ते।।5.34.18।। पृच्छामि त्वां हरिश्रेष्ठ प्रिया रामकथा हि मे।
372.e: "O great vanara, If on the other hand you have come here as Rama's messenger I wish you well. I love Rama's story. Tell me.

372.sa: गुणान्रामस्य कथय प्रियस्य मम वानर।।5.34.19।। चित्तं हरसि मे सौम्य नदीकूलं यथा रयः।
372.e: "O vanara Rama's virtues are dear to me to hear. O gentle one just as the current of the river wears away its banks, my mind is lured by your presence.

372.sa: अहो स्वप्नस्य सुखता याहमेवं चिराहृता।।5.34.20।। प्रेषितं नाम पश्यामि राघवेण वनौकसम्।
372.e: "Oh I have been seeing the person sent by Rama in my dream for a long time. This is a pleasant dream to me.

372.sa: स्वप्नेऽपि यद्यहं वीरं राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम्।।5.34.21।। पश्येयं नावसीदेयं स्वप्नोऽपि मम मत्सरी।
372.e: "Even if I can see the heroic Rama together with Lakshmana in my dream my pain will be gone. Even the dream is inimical to me (I cannot sleep and thus cannot dream.)

372.sa: नाहं स्वप्नमिमं मन्ये स्वप्ने दृष्ट्वा हि वानरम्।।5.34.22।। न शक्योऽभ्युदयः प्राप्तुं प्राप्तश्चाभ्युदयो मम।
372.e: "I do not think it is a dream. Pleasure cannot be experienced by seeing a vanara in a dream. I experience pleasure now (seeing a monkey in a dream is a bad omen).

372.sa: किन्नु स्याचित्तमोहोऽयं भवेद्वातगतिस्त्वियम्।।5.34.23।। उन्मादजो विकारो वा स्यादियं मृगतृष्णिका।
372.e: "Can this be a delusion of my mind or a mental imbalance (resulting in movement of the mind in the body). Is it a malady born of  my madness? Or is it a mirage?

372.sa: अथवा नायमुन्मादो मोहोऽप्युन्मादलक्षणः।।5.34.24।। सम्बुध्ये चाहमात्मानमियं चापि वनौकसम्।
372.e: "No, this cannot be insanity. nor even delusion. But I recognise this vanara well"

372.sa: इत्येवं बहुधा सीता सम्प्रधार्य बलाबलम्।।5.34.25।। रक्षसां कामरूपत्वान्मेने तं राक्षसाधिपम्।
372.e: Considering the strength and weakness of demons in that manner Sita thought that Hanuman was none other than the king of demons who can asume any form at will.

372.sa: एतां बुद्धिं तदा कृत्वा सीता सा तनुमध्यमा।।5.34.26।। न प्रतिव्याजहाराथ वानरं जनकात्मजा।
372.e: Having entertained such thoughts, Sita, the lady with a fairwaist, daughter of Janaka,  did not respond to the vanara.

372.sa: सीतायाश्चिन्तितं बुद्ध्वा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.34.27।। श्रोत्रानुकूलैर्वचनैस्तदा तां संप्रहर्षयत्।
372.e: Hanuman, son of the Windgod understood what was going on in Sita's mind and spoke pleasing words that brought joy in her.

372.sa: आदित्य इव तेजस्वी लोककान्तश्शशी यथा।।5.34.28।। राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवो वैश्रवणो यथा। विक्रमेणोपपन्नश्च यथा विष्णुर्महायशाः।।5.34.29।।
372.e: "Rama is glorious as the Sun, brings delight to the whole world like the Moon, is the king of kings like Vaisravana,  and renowned like Visnu endowed with valour.

372.sa: आदित्य इव तेजस्वी लोककान्तश्शशी यथा।।5.34.28।। राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवो वैश्रवणो यथा। विक्रमेणोपपन्नश्च यथा विष्णुर्महायशाः।।5.34.29।।
372.e: "Rama is glorious as the Sun, brings delight to the whole world like the Moon, is the king of kings like Vaisravana,  and renowned like Visnu endowed with valour.

372.sa: सत्यवादी मधुरवाग्देवो वाचस्पतिर्यथा। रूपवान्सुभग श्रीमान् कन्दर्प इव मूर्तिमान्।।5.34.30।।
372.e: "He is truthful in speech like Brihaspati, prosperous (like Kubera), sweettongued, handsome, graceful like Kamadeva.

372.sa: स्थानक्रोधः प्रहर्ता च श्रेष्ठो लोके महारथः। बाहुच्छायामवष्टब्धो यस्य लोको महात्मनः।।5.34.31।।
372.e: "He shows anger to one who deserves it, he is the foremost charioteer of the world and he is a great self under the shadow of whose shoulders the whole world takes refuge.

372.sa: अपकृष्याश्रमपदान्मृगरूपेण राघवम्। शून्ये येनापनीतासि तस्य द्रक्ष्यसि यत्फलम्।।5.34.32।।
372.e: "You will see the consequences of the action of Ravana who abducted you deceitfully in the form of deer when Rama was away from the hermitage.

372.sa: न चिराद्रावणं संख्ये यो वधिष्यति वीर्यवान्। रोषप्रमुक्तैरिषुभिर्ज्वलद्भिरिव पावकैः।।5.34.33।। तेनाहं प्रेषितो दूत स्त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः। त्वद्वियोगेन दुःखार्त स्स त्वां कौशलमब्रवीत्।।5.34.34।।
372.e: "Heroic Rama will soon release many scorching, fiery arrows in anger and kill Ravana. I seek your permission as an envoy of Rama. Filled with grief by your separation, he has made inquiries about your welfare.

372.sa: न चिराद्रावणं संख्ये यो वधिष्यति वीर्यवान्। रोषप्रमुक्तैरिषुभिर्ज्वलद्भिरिव पावकैः।।5.34.33।। तेनाहं प्रेषितो दूत स्त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः। त्वद्वियोगेन दुःखार्त स्स त्वां कौशलमब्रवीत्।।5.34.34।।
372.e: "Heroic Rama will soon release many scorching, fiery arrows in anger and kill Ravana. I seek your permission as an envoy of Rama. Filled with grief by your separation, he has made inquiries about your welfare.

372.sa: लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजास्सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः। अभिवाद्य महाबाहुस्स त्वां कौशलमब्रवीत्।।5.34.35।।
372.e: "The brilliant, longarmed Lakshmana, delight of Sumitra enquires about your welfare and offers salutations to you.

372.sa: रामस्य च सखा देवि सुग्रीवो नाम वानरः। राजा वानरमुख्यानां स त्वां कौशलमब्रवीत्।।5.34.36।।
372.e: "O goddess like lady Rama's friend Sugriva, king of vanara chieftans inquires about your wellbeing.

372.sa: नित्यं स्मरति रामस्त्वां ससुग्रीव स्सलक्ष्मणः। दिष्ट्या जीवसि वैदेहि राक्षसीवशमागता।।5.34.37।।
372.e: "O Vaidehi Rama, Lakshmana and Sugriva always remember you. Luckily you are alive even though you are under the clutches of shedemons.

372.sa: नचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसे रामं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। मध्ये वानरकोटीनां सुग्रीवं चामितौजसम्।।5.34.38।।
372.e: "Very soon you will see mighty Rama, Lakshmana and Sugriva of unlimited prowess surrounded by crores of vanaras.

372.sa: अहं सुग्रीवसचिवो हनुमान्नाम वानरः। प्रविष्टो नगरीं लङ्कां लङ्घयित्वा महोदधिम्।।5.34.39।।
372.e: "I am Sugriva's minister known as Hanuman, a vanara who entered the city of Lanka after leaping over the great ocean.

372.sa: कृत्वा मूर्ध्नि पदन्यासं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। त्वां द्रष्टुमुपयातोऽहं समाश्रित्य पराक्रमम्।।5.34.40।।
372.e: "Setting my foot with my valour on the head of the cruelminded Ravana, using my valour,  I came here to see you.

372.sa: नाहमस्मि तथा देवि यथा मामवगच्छसि। विशङ्का त्यज्यतामेषा श्रद्धत्स्व वदतो मम।।5.34.41।।
372.e: "O goddesslike lady I am not  a deceitful person as you suppose me to be. Shake off your suspicion as I speak to you and trust me." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfourth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

373.sa: तां तु रामकथां श्रुत्वा वैदेही वानरर्षभात्। उवाच वचनं सान्त्वमिदं मधुरया गिरा।।5.35.1।।
373.e: On hearing about Rama from the bull among vanaras, thus spoke Vaidehi politely in a sweet voice:

373.sa: क्व ते रामेण संसर्गः कथं जानासि लक्ष्मणम्। वानराणां नराणां च कथमासीत्समागमः।।5.35.2।।
373.e: "Where did you come in contact with Rama? How did you assess Lakshmana? How did an alliance of vanaras and humans take place?

373.sa: यानि रामस्य लिङ्गानि लक्ष्मणस्य च वानर। तानि भूयस्समाचक्ष्व न मां शोकस्समाविशेत्।।5.35.3।।
373.e: "O vanara tell me all about the identification marks of Rama and Lakshmana again so that grief does not enter my mind.

373.sa: कीदृशं तस्य संस्थानं रूपं रामस्य कीदृशम्। कथमूरू कथं बाहू लक्ष्मणस्य च शंस मे।।5.35.4।।
373.e: "What does Rama look like? And Laksmana? How are his thighs, arms? Tell me".

373.sa: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदेह्या हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। ततो रामं यथातत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे।।5.35.5।।
373.e: Questioned thus by Vaidehi, Hanuman, son of the Windgod started describing Rama's physique as it is.

373.sa: जानन्ती बत दिष्ट्या मां वैदेहि परिपृच्छसि। भर्तुः कमलपत्त्राक्षि संस्थानं लक्ष्मणस्य च।।5.35.6।।
373.e: "O Vaidehi with eyes like lotus petals although you know your husband's and Lakshmana's form and distinguishing marks, it is my good fortune that you asked me (to describe them).

373.sa: यानि रामस्य चिह्नानि लक्ष्मणस्य च यानि वै। लक्षितानि विशालाक्षि वदतश्शृणु तानि मे।।5.35.7।।
373.e: "O largeeyed lady I will describe those distinguishing marks of Rama and Lakshmana Listen.

373.sa: रामः कमलपत्त्राक्ष स्सर्वसत्त्वमनोहरः। रूपदाक्षिण्यसम्पन्नः प्रसूतो जनकात्मजे।।5.35.8।।
373.e: "O daughter of Janaka Rama with eyes like lotus petals is a person born with a delightful form, richly endowed with indescribable charm and politeness.

373.sa: तेजसाऽदित्य सङ्काशः क्षमया पृथिवीसमः। बृहस्पतिसमो बुद्ध्या यशसा वासवोपमः।।5.35.9।।
373.e: "He vies with the Sun in effulgence, with earth in forbearance, with Brihaspati in intelligence, and in fame with Indra.

373.sa: रक्षिता जीवलोकस्य स्वजनस्याभिरक्षिता। रक्षिता स्वस्य वृत्तस्य धर्मस्य च परन्तपः।।5.35.10।।
373.e: "Rama is a protector of the entire world of living beings not to speak of his own people. He is a protector of his own race. He guards righteousness. He is a scorcher of enemies.

373.sa: रामो भामिनि लोकस्य चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य रक्षिता। मर्यादानां च लोकस्य कर्ता कारयिता च सः।।5.35.11।।
373.e: "O beautiful lady Rama is a protector of the four classes of society (Brahmana, Kshatriya, Vaisya and Sudra) in the world. He follows codes of conduct and makes others follow them.

373.sa: अर्चिष्मानर्चितोऽत्यर्थं ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितः। साधूनामुपकारज्ञः प्रचारज्ञश्च कर्मणाम्।।5.35.12।।
373.e: "He is luminous and highly revered. He observes vow of selfcontrol. He is steadfast and recognises services rendered by sages. He is aware of the rites and the ways of administration.

373.sa: राजविद्याविनीतश्च ब्राह्मणानामुपासिता। श्रुतवान्शीलसम्पन्नो विनीतश्च परन्तपः।।5.35.13।।
373.e: "He is welltrained in statecraft. He is devoted to brahmins. Endowed with an excellent conduct, he is learned in scriptures and a scorcher of enemies.

373.sa: यजुर्वेदविनीतश्च वेदविद्भिस्सुपूजितः। धनुर्वेदे च वेदेषु वेदाङ्गेषु च निष्ठितः।।5.35.14।।
373.e: "He is versed in Yajurveda and is respected by Vedic scholars. He has mastered Dhanurveda and other Vedas and auxillary Vedas as well.

373.sa: विपुलांसो महाबाहुः कम्बुग्रीवश्शुभाननः। गूढजत्रुस्सुताम्राक्षो रामो देवि जनै श्श्रुतः।।5.35.15।।
373.e: "O godlike lady Rama has broad shoulders, strong arms, conchshaped neck and an auspicious countenance. With his fleshy round arms and copperyred eyes, he is renowned in all the worlds.

373.sa: दुन्दुभिस्वननिर्घोष स्स्निग्धवर्णः प्रतापवान्। सम स्समविभक्ताङ्गो वर्णं श्यामं समाश्रितः।।5.35.16।।
373.e: "His tone is resonant like drums, he has a beautiful, dark, shining complexion. He has symmetrical, well proportioned limbs. He is neither too tall nor too short.

373.sa: त्रिस्थिरस्त्रिप्रलम्बश्च त्रिसमस्त्रिषु चोन्नतः। त्रिताम्रस्त्रिषु च स्निग्धो गम्भीरस्त्रिषु नित्यशः।।5.35.17।।
373.e: "He has three stiff parts, three long parts, three even parts, three shining parts, elevated in three parts, has three raised parts, his body has lines in three parts and is  of coppery reddish colour in three parts. He has a majestic look.

373.sa: त्रिवलीवांस्त्र्यवनतश्चतुर्व्यङ्गस्त्रिशीर्षवान्। चतुष्कलश्चतुर्लेखश्चतुष्किष्कुश्चतु स्समः।।5.35.18।।
373.e: "He has three folds in the skin of his neck and belly, is depressed in the middle of his soles and the nipples, undersized at four placesthe neck, penis, shanks and back, has three spirals on his head, has four lines under his thumb, has four lines on his forehead, he is a person with four cubits in height and symmetrical arms, cheeks and thighs.

373.sa: चतुर्दशसमद्वन्द्वश्चतुर्दंष्ट्रश्चतुर्गतिः। महोष्ठहनुनासश्च पञ्चस्निग्धोऽष्टवंशवान्।।5.35.19।।
373.e: "He is a person with his pairs of eyebrows, nostrils, eyes, ears, lips, nipples, elbows, wrists, knees, testicles, loins, arms, legs and buttocks in good symmetry he has four sharp teeth. He walks in different gaits like a lion, leopard, elephant and bull as occasion demands he has sharp nose, charming lips and jaws. He has smooth hair, eyes, skin, teeth and feet and his eight parts of his body namely back, trunk, limbs, fingers, toes, eyes and testicles are long.

373.sa: दशपद्मो दशबृहत्त्रिभिर्व्याप्तो द्विशुक्लवान्। षडुन्नतो नवतनुस्त्रिभिर्व्याप्नोति राघवः।।5.35.20।।
373.e: "Ten limbs of the body resemble lotuses. He has proportionate limbs. He is known by the virtue of his spledour, fame and glory. Both his teeth and eyes are fair. Six parts of his body are elevated, nine parts of his body are fine and sharp. He pursues spiritual merit, worldly comfort and sensual delight in three periods of the dayforenoon, midday and evening. He always adopts the righteous way of life.

373.sa: सत्यधर्मपरश्श्रीमान् सङ्ग्रहानुग्रहे रतः। देशकालविभागज्ञस्सर्वलोकप्रियंवदः।।5.35.21।।
373.e: "He is ever established in truth and righteousness. He is prosperous and desires to accumulate wealth in order to shower favour on others. He knows the right use of time and place in discharging his duties. He has endeared himself to all by his words.

373.sa: भ्राता तस्य च द्वैमात्रस्सौमित्रिरपराजितः। अनुरागेण रूपेण गुणैश्चैव तथाविधः।।5.35.22।।
373.e: "His invincible brother Saumitri born of a different mother is a replica of Rama in affection, charm and virtues.

373.sa: तावुभौ नरशार्दूलौ त्वद्दर्शनसमुत्सुकौ। विचिन्वन्तौ महीं कृत्स्नामस्माभिरभिसङ्गतौ।।5.35.23।।
373.e: "While earnestly searching for you all over the earth both tigers among men came in contact with us.

373.sa: त्वामेव मार्गमाणौ तौ विचरन्तौ वसुन्धराम्। ददर्शतुर्मृगपतिं पूर्वजेनावरोपितम्।।5.35.24।। ऋश्यमूकस्य पृष्ठे तु बहुपादपसङ्कुले। भ्रातुर्भयार्तमासीनं सुग्रीवं प्रियदर्शनम्।।5.35.25।।
373.e: "While both of them were wandering, searching for you all over the earth they saw Sugriva, the lord of animals who had been thrown out of kingship by his elder brother and was living on the mountain Rshyamuka frightened of him.

373.sa: त्वामेव मार्गमाणौ तौ विचरन्तौ वसुन्धराम्। ददर्शतुर्मृगपतिं पूर्वजेनावरोपितम्।।5.35.24।। ऋश्यमूकस्य पृष्ठे तु बहुपादपसङ्कुले। भ्रातुर्भयार्तमासीनं सुग्रीवं प्रियदर्शनम्।।5.35.25।।
373.e: "While both of them were wandering, searching for you all over the earth they saw Sugriva, the lord of animals who had been thrown out of kingship by his elder brother and was living on the mountain Rshyamuka frightened of him.

373.sa: वयं तु हरिराजं तं सुग्रीवं सत्यसङ्गरम्। परिचर्यामहे राज्यात्पूर्वजेनावरोपितम्।।5.35.26।।
373.e: "Sugriva, king of vanaras who is committed to defend truth has been deposed from the kingdom by his elder brother. We keep attending on him.

373.sa: ततस्तौ चीरवसनौ धनुः प्रवरपाणिनौ। ऋश्यमूकस्य शैलस्य रम्यं देशमुपागतौ।।5.35.27।।
373.e: "Both the princes clad in bark robes and armed with powerful bows reached the beautiful location of Rshyamukha mountain.

373.sa: स तौ दृष्ट्वा नरव्याघ्रौ धन्विनौ वानरर्षभः। अवप्लुतो गिरेस्तस्य शिखरं भयमोहितः।।5.35.28।।
373.e: "On seeing the tigers among men armed with bows, Sugriva, the bull among vanaras jumped from the mountain deluded with fear and reached the peak.

373.sa: ततस्स शिखरे तस्मिन्वानरेन्द्रो व्यवस्थितः। तयोस्समीपं मामेव प्रेषयामास सत्वरम्।।5.35.29।।
373.e: "Thereafter the lord of vanaras staying on the mountain top quickly sent me to meet both of them.

373.sa: तावहं पुरुषव्याघ्रौ सुग्रीववचनात्प्रभू। रूपलक्षणसम्पन्नौ कृताञ्जलिरुपस्थितः।।5.35.30।।
तौ परिज्ञाततत्त्वार्थौ मया प्रीतिसमन्वितौ। पृष्ठमारोप्य तं देशं प्रापितौ पुरुषर्षभौ।।5.35.31।।
373.e: "I recognised the true status of  both the mighty men who were filled with joy, placed them on my back, and reached the mountaintop.

373.sa: निवेदितौ च तत्त्वेन सुग्रीवाय महात्मने। तयोरन्योन्यसल्लापाद्भृशं प्रीतिरजायत।।5.35.32।।
373.e: "I reported faithfully about both the highsouled men to Sugriva. As they got to know each other through conversation a fast friendship developed between them.

373.sa: ततस्तौ प्रीतिसम्पन्नौ हरीश्वरनरेश्वरौ। परस्परकृताश्वासौ कथया पूर्ववृत्तया।।5.35.33।।
ततस्स सान्त्वयामास सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। स्त्रीहेतोर्वालिना भ्रात्रा निरस्तमुरुतेजसा।।5.35.34।।
373.e: "Then Rama, consoled Sugriva who was dethroned and abandoned on acount of a woman by his brother Vali, endowed with great prowess.

373.sa: ततस्त्वन्नाशजं शोकं रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। लक्ष्मणो वानरेन्द्राय सुग्रीवाय न्यवेदयत्।।5.35.35।।
373.e: "Then Lakshmana spoke to the lord of vanaras, Sugriva about your loss and the grief caused to Rama, who is adept in accomplishing difficult deeds with ease.

373.sa: स श्रुत्वा वानरेन्द्रस्तु लक्ष्मणेनेरितं वचः। तदासीन्निष्प्रभोऽत्यर्थं ग्रहग्रस्त इवांशुमान्।।5.35.36।।
373.e: "Having heard the words of Lakshmana, the king of vanaras became extremely lustreless like the Sun overshadowed by the planet Rahu.

373.sa: ततस्त्वद्गात्रशोभीनि रक्षसा ह्रियमाणया। यान्याभरणजालानि पातितानि महीतले।।5.35.37।। तानि सर्वाणि रामाय आनीय हरियूथपाः। संहृष्टा दर्शयामासुर्गतिं तु न विदुस्तव।।5.35.38।।
ततस्त्वद्गात्रशोभीनि रक्षसा ह्रियमाणया। यान्याभरणजालानि पातितानि महीतले।।5.35.37।। तानि सर्वाणि रामाय आनीय हरियूथपाः। संहृष्टा दर्शयामासुर्गतिं तु न विदुस्तव।।5.35.38।।
तानि रामाय दत्तानि मयैवोपहृतानि च। स्वनवन्त्यवकीर्णानि तस्मिन्विगतचेतसि।।5.35.39।।
373.e: "I collected the ornaments and gave them to Rama. He lost his senses on seeing the jingling ornaments scattered.

373.sa: तान्यङ्के दर्शनीयानि कृत्वा बहुविधं तव। तेन देवप्रकाशेन देवेन परिदेवितम्।।5.35.40।।
373.e: "The divine self who is effulgent like god wailed in many ways placing the beautiful ornaments on his lap.

373.sa: पश्यतस्तानि रुदतस्ताम्यतश्च पुनः पुनः। प्रादीपयन्दाशरथेस्तानि शोकहुताशनम्।।5.35.41।।
373.e: "Rama looked at them and wept clasping them again and again in grief which inflamed like fire.

373.sa: शयितं च चिरं तेन दुःखार्तेन महात्मना। मयापि विविधैर्वाक्यैः कृच्छ्रादुत्थापितः पुनः।।5.35.42।।
373.e: "Rama, the great self, immersed in sorrow lay down on the ground. I also consoled him with great difficulty and helped him to get up.

373.sa: तानि दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्दर्शयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः। राघवस्सह सौमित्रिस्सुग्रीवे स न्यवेदयत्।।5.35.43।।
373.e: "Longarmed Rama along with Lakshmana looked at them again and again and gave them to the care of Sugriva.

373.sa: स तवादर्शनादार्ये राघवः परितप्यते। महता ज्वलता नित्यमग्निनेवाग्निपर्वतः।।5.35.44।।
373.e: "O divine lady on account of your separation he is ever blazing like a mountain of fire (Samvartaka).

373.sa: त्वत्कृते तमनिद्रा च शोकश्चिन्ता च राघवम्। तापयन्ति महात्मानमग्न्यगारमिवाग्नयः।।5.35.45।।
373.e: "Rama is burning like a furnace by (three fires) sleeplessness, grief and intense anxiety just as the three sacred fires keep a firesanctuary intensely heated.

373.sa: तवादर्शनशोकेन राघवः प्रविचाल्यते। महता भूमिकम्पेन महानिव शिलोच्चयः।।5.35.46।।
373.e: "On account of sorrow caused by not being able to see you, Rama of Raghu dynasty is shaken up like a lofty mountain is shaken by earthquake.

373.sa: काननानि सुरम्याणि नदीः प्रस्रवणानि च। चरन्न रतिमाप्नोति त्वामपश्यन्नृपात्मजे।।5.35.47।।
373.e: "Oh princess unable to see you, Rama has found no joy in roaming delightful forests, rivers and streams.

373.sa: स त्वां मनुजशार्दूलः क्षिप्रं प्राप्स्यति राघवः। समित्रबान्धवं हत्वा रावणं जनकात्मजे।।5.35.48।।
373.e: "Oh daughter of Janaka after killing Ravana, along with his friends and relatives Rama, the tiger among men, will meet you.

373.sa: सहितौ रामसुग्रीवावुभावकुरुतां तदा। समयं वालिनं हन्तुं तव चान्वेषणं तथा।।5.35.49।।
373.e: "(Having become friends) Rama and Sugriva together reached an agreement to kill Vali and search for you.

373.sa: ततस्ताभ्यां कुमाराभ्यां वीराभ्यां स हरीश्वरः। किष्किन्धां समुपागम्य वाली युद्धे निपातितः।।5.35.50।।
373.e: "Thereafter both the princes together arrived at Kishkinda and killed Vali, king of vanaras in a combat.

373.sa: ततो निहत्य तरसा रामो वालिनमाहवे। सर्वर्क्षहरिसङ्घानां सुग्रीवमकरोत्पतिम्।।5.35.51।।
373.e: "Then Rama quickly killed Vali in a combat and made Sugriva the lord of all troops of vanaras and bears.

373.sa: रामसुग्रीवयोरैक्यं देव्येवं समजायत। हनुमन्तं च मां विद्धि तयोर्दूतमिहागतम्।।5.35.52।।
373.e: "Oh Illustrious lady In that manner alliance was established between Rama and Sugriva. Know me to be Hanuman, arrived here as their messenger.

373.sa: स्वराज्यं प्राप्य सुग्रीवस्समानीय हरीश्वरान्। त्वदर्थं प्रेषयामास दिशो दश महाबलान्।।5.35.53।।
373.e: "Having obtained his kingdom Sugriva despatched the vanara leaders to all ten directions (to search for you).

373.sa: आदिष्टा वानरेन्द्रेण सुग्रीवेण महौजसा। अद्रिराजप्रतीकाशास्सर्वतः प्रस्थितौ महीम्।।5.35.54।।
373.e: "Following Sugriva's orders, the powerful monkey leaders huge as the Himalayas, king of mountains went all over the earth (searching).

373.sa: ततस्ते मार्गमाणा वै सुग्रीववचनातुराः। चरन्ति वसुधां कृत्स्नां वयमन्ये च वानराः।।5.35.55।।
373.e: "Following Sugriva's orders, we, the monkeys, since then are moving about searching the entire earth eager to find you or to carry out Sugriva's orders.

373.sa: अङ्गदो नाम लक्ष्मीवान्वालिसूनुर्महाबलः। प्रस्थितः कपिशार्दूलस्त्रिभागबलसंवृतः।।5.35.56।।
तेषां नो विप्रणष्टानां विन्ध्ये पर्वतसत्तमे। भृशं शोकपरीतानामहोरात्रगणा गताः।।5.35.57।।
373.e: "We wasted many nights and days immersed in disappointment (for not being able to find you) and we missed our path in the great Vindhya mountain.

373.sa: ते वयं कार्यनैराश्यात्कालस्यातिक्रमेण च। भयाच्च कपिराजस्य प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं व्यवस्थिताः।।5.35.58।।
373.e: "We decided to give up our lives due to disappointment, transgression of the time limit  fixed for us and fear of the monkey lord (fear of facing the king without finding you).

373.sa: विचित्य वनदुर्गाणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च। अनासाद्य पदं देव्याः प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं समुद्यताः।।5.35.59।।
373.e: "We decided to give up our lives since we were unable to see the feet of the queen (Sita) even after searching the forest fortresses and the (banks of) mountain streams.

373.sa: दृष्ट्वा प्रायोपविष्टांश्च सर्वान्वानरपुङ्गवान्। भृशं शोकार्णवे मग्नः पर्यदेवयदङ्गदः।।5.35.60।। तव नाशं च वैदेहि वालिनश्च वधं तथा। प्रायोपवेशमस्माकं मरणं च जटायुषः।।5.35.61।।
दृष्ट्वा प्रायोपविष्टांश्च सर्वान्वानरपुङ्गवान्। भृशं शोकार्णवे मग्नः पर्यदेवयदङ्गदः।।5.35.60।। तव नाशं च वैदेहि वालिनश्च वधं तथा। प्रायोपवेशमस्माकं मरणं च जटायुषः।।5.35.61।।
तेषां नस्वामिसन्देशान्निराशानां मुमूर्षताम्। कार्यहेतोरिवायातश्शकुनिर्वीर्यवान्महान्।।5.35.62।।
