373.e: "When we were disappointed (in tracing you) and were at the point of death having been commanded by the king (that whosoever overstays would be killed) a gigantic powerful bird appeared to fulfil our task.

373.sa: गृध्रराजस्य सोदर्यः सम्पातिर्नाम गृध्रराट्। श्रुत्वा भ्रातृवधं कोपादिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।5.35.63।।
373.e: "That king of vultures, Sampati was the brother of king of birds Jatayu. Hearing about the death of his younger brother Sampati felt distresed and spoke in anger:

373.sa: यवीयान्केन मे भ्राता हतः क्व च निपातितः। एतदाख्यातुमिच्छामि भवद्भिर्वानरोत्तमाः।।5.35.64।।
373.e: 'O best of vanaras by whom was my younger brother killed? Where was he dropped down? I wish you to tell me all about that.

373.sa: अङ्गदोऽकथयत्तस्य जनस्थाने महद्वधम्। रक्षसा भीमरूपेण त्वामुद्दिश्य यथातथम्।।5.35.65।।
जटायुषो वधं श्रुत्वा दुःखितस्सोऽरुणात्मजः। त्वां शशंस वरारोहे वसन्तीं रावणालये।।5.35.66।।
373.e: "Having heard about the death of Jatayu, O charming lady that Sampati Aruna's son felt sad and told us that you are at Ravana's palace.

373.sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्पातेः प्रीतिवर्धनम्। अङ्गदप्रमुखास्तूर्णं ततस्सम्प्रस्थिता वयम्।।5.35.67।।
373.e: "Having heard Sampati's encouraging words all of us led by Angada departed immediately.

373.sa: विन्ध्यादुत्थाय सम्प्राप्ता स्सागरस्यान्तमुत्तरम्। त्वद्धर्शनकृतोत्साहा हृष्टास्तुष्टाः प्लवङ्गमाः।।5.35.68।।
373.e: "The happy monkeys were satisfied. Enthusiastic about seeing you, they rose from the Vindhya mountain and reached the limit of the sea  shore in the north.

373.sa: अङ्गदप्रमुखास्सर्वे वेलोपान्तमुपस्थिताः। चिन्तां जग्मुः पुनर्भीतास्त्वद्दर्शनसमुत्सुकाः।।5.35.69।।
अथाहं हरिसैन्यस्य सागरं प्रेक्ष्य सीदतः। व्यवधूय भयं तीव्रं योजनानां शतं प्लुतः।।5.35.70।।
373.e: "When the vanara army was feeling despondent at the sight of the ocean, I leaped across the sea, a hundred yojanas, pushing aside  all my fear.

373.sa: लङ्का चापि मया रात्रौ प्रविष्टा राक्षसाकुला। रावणश्च मया दृष्टस्त्वं च शोकपरिप्लुता।।5.35.71।।
373.e: "I entered at night the city of Lanka teeming with demons and saw Ravana and saw you immersed in sorrow.

373.sa: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथावृत्तमनन्दिते। अभिभाषस्व मां देवि दूतो दाशरथेरहम्।।5.35.72।।
373.e: "O sinless lady I have given you a faithful account. I am a messenger of Dasaratha's son. And you may speak now, O divine lady

373.sa: तं मां रामकृतोद्योगं त्वन्निमित्तमिहागतम्। सुग्रीवसचिवं देवि बुद्ध्यस्व पवनात्मजम्।।5.35.73।।
373.e: "O divine lady Know that I have come here for your cause carrying out the mission of Rama. I am Sugriva'a minister and son of the Windgod.

373.sa: कुशली तव काकुत्स्थस्सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। गुरोराराधने युक्तो लक्ष्मणश्च सुलक्षणः।।5.35.74।।
373.e: "Your lord Rama of Kakutstha race, supreme among wielders of weapons is doing well. So is venerable Lakshmana endowed with auspicious signs engaged in serving him.

373.sa: तस्य वीर्यवतो देवि भर्तुस्तव हिते रतः। अहमेकस्तु सम्प्राप्त स्सुग्रीववचनादिह।।5.35.75।।
373.e: "O queen seeking the welfare of your Valiant husband I came here at the behest of Sugriva all alone.

373.sa: मयेयमसहायेन चरता कामरूपिणा। दक्षिणा दिगनुक्रान्ता त्वन्मार्गविचयैषिणा।।5.35.76।।
373.e: "I can assume any form at my will. I searched for you without any help moving in the southern direction and reached this place .

373.sa: दिष्ट्याहं हरिसैन्यानां त्वन्नाशमनुशोचताम्। अपनेष्यामि सन्तापं तवाभिगमशंसनात्।।5.35.77।।
373.e: "Fortunately for me I can finally dispel the fear of the vanara chiefs who are regretting your loss, by letting them know that you have been found.

373.sa: दिष्ट्या हि मम न व्यर्थं देवि सागरलङ्घनम्। प्राप्स्याम्यहमिदं दिष्ट्या त्वद्दर्शनकृतं यशः।।5.35.78।।
373.e: "Oh queen luckily for me, crossing the ocean has not gone in vain. I am fortunate because I will attain fame of finding you.

373.sa: राघवश्च महावीर्यः क्षिप्रं त्वामभिपत्स्यते। समित्रबान्धवं हत्वा रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्।।5.35.79।।
373.e: "Mighty Raghava will take you after killing Ravana, the king of demons along with his kith and kin.

373.sa: माल्यवान्नाम वैदेहि गिरीणामुत्तमो गिरिः। ततो गच्छति गोकर्णं पर्वतं केसरी हरिः।।5.35.80।।
373.e: "Oh Vaidehi there is a famous mountain called Malyavan. From there a monkey called Kesari went to mount Gokarna.

373.sa: स च देवर्षिभिर्दिष्टः पिता मम महाकपिः। तीर्थे नदीपतेः पुण्ये शम्बसादनमुद्धरत्।।5.35.81।।
373.e: "He (Kesari) is said to be my father by the divine sages. He retrieved a piece of land in a holy spot of that sea shore and killed Sambasadana, a demon who was oppressing righteous people.

373.sa: तस्याहं हरिणः क्षेत्रे जातो वातेन मैथिलि। हनुमानिति विख्यातो लोके स्वेनैव कर्मणा।।5.35.82।।
373.e: "O Mythili I was born in that land retrieved by the Windgod. I am known as Hanuman by virtue of my own action.

373.sa: विश्वासार्थं तु वैदेहि भर्तुरुक्ता मया गुणाः। अचिराद्राघवो देवि त्वामितो नयिताऽनघे।।5.35.83।।
373.e: "In order to inspire confidence in you about me I have narrated the virtues of your husband. O sinless queen Rama will take you from here very soon".

373.sa: एवं विश्वासिता सीता हेतुभिश्शोककर्शिता। उपपन्नैरभिज्ञानैर्दूतं तमवगच्छति।।5.35.84।।
373.e: The griefstricken Sita trusted him by his logical presentation of reasons as well as identifications. She believed that he was a messenger (of Rama).

373.sa: अतुलं च गता हर्षं प्रहर्षेण च जानकी। नेत्राभ्यां वक्रपक्ष्माभ्यां मुमोचानन्दजं जलम्।।5.35.85।।
373.e: Janaki experienced immeasurable happiness and shed tears of joy through her curved eyes.

373.sa: चारु तद्वदनं तस्यास्ताम्रशुक्लायतेक्षणम्। अशोभत विशालाक्ष्या राहुमुक्त इवोडुराट्।।5.35.86।।
373.e: Her face with large eyes with a tinge of red corners shone like the Moon released from Rahu.

373.sa: हनुमन्तं कपिं व्यक्तं मन्यते नान्यथेति सा। अथोवाच हनूमांस्तामुत्तरं प्रियदर्शनाम्।।5.35.87।।
373.e: She realised that the monkey was none other than Hanuman. Then he looked at her who was pleasing to see and spoke again:

373.sa: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं समाश्वसिहि मैथिलि। किं करोमि कथं वा ते रोचते प्रतियाम्यहम्।।5.35.88।।
373.e: "Mythili, everything I intended to say has been narrated to you. Calm yourself down. What shall I do? Or else, tell me what pleases you. I shall go back.

373.sa: हतेऽसुरे संयति शम्बसादने कपिप्रवीरेण महर्षिचोदनात्। ततोऽस्मि वायुप्रभवो हि मैथिलि प्रभावतस्तत्प्रतिमश्च वानरः।।5.35.89।।
373.e: "(My father) a mighty monkey killed Sambasadana in a battle on the command of a great seer. I am a vanara (born to a monkey) by the impact of the Windgod. I am equal to the Windgod in power." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

374.sa: भूय एव महातेजा हनूमान्पवनात्मजः। अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सीताप्रत्ययकारणात्।।5.36.1।।
374.e: Mighty Hanuman, the son of the Windgod again spoke to Sita humbly to inspire confidence in her.

374.sa: वानरोऽहं महाभागे दूतो रामस्य धीमतः। रामनामाङ्कितं चेदं पश्य देव्यङ्गुलीयकम्।।5.36.2।।
374.e: "O noble lady I am a vanara, an envoy of learned Rama. You see this ring with Rama's name inscribed on it, O godlike lady

374.sa: प्रत्ययार्थं तवाऽनीतं तेन दत्तं महात्मना। समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते क्षीणदुःखफला ह्यसि।।5.36.3।।
374.e: "Be calm. Be blessed. Your sorrows have come to an end. This (the ring) is given by the great self, Rama, to make you trust me.

374.sa: गृहीत्वा प्रेक्षमाणा सा भर्तुः करविभूषणम्। भर्तारमिव सम्प्राप्ता जानकी मुदिताऽभवत्।।5.36.4।।
374.e: She received the ornament that adorned her husband's hand and gazed at it and felt delighted as though her husband had arrived.

374.sa: चारु तद्वदनं तस्यास्ताम्रशुक्लायतेक्षणम्। अशोभत विशालाक्ष्या राहुमुक्त इवोडुराट्।।5.36.5।।
374.e: Her beautiful countenance with large white eyes with a reddish tinge in the corners shone like the Moon released from Rahu.

374.sa: ततस्सा ह्रीमती बाला भर्तृसन्देशहर्षिता। परितुष्टा प्रियं कृत्वा प्रशशंस महाकपिम्।।5.36.6।।
374.e: Young Sita felt delighted about her husband's news and blushed. By praising him for his action, she pleased the great monkey.

374.sa: विक्रान्तस्त्वं समर्थस्त्वं प्राज्ञस्त्वं वानरोत्तम। येनेदं राक्षसपदं त्वयैकेन प्रधर्षितम्।।5.36.7।।
374.e: "O foremost among the vanaras you have trespassed the abodes of demons all alone. You are mighty and capable and wise.

374.sa: शतयोजनविस्तीर्ण स्सागरो मकरालयः। विक्रमश्लाघनीयेन क्रमता गोष्पदीकृतः।।5.36.8।।
374.e: "You with your admirable prowess have reduced this ocean which is an abode of crocodiles stretching over a hundred yojanas to a cow's hoof mark.

374.sa: न हि त्वां प्राकृतं मन्ये वानरं वानरर्षभ। यस्य ते नास्ति सन्त्रासो रावणान्नापि सम्भ्रमः।।5.36.9।।
374.e: "I do not think you are an ordinary monkey. You have no fear or excitement about Ravana. You are a bull among vanaras.

374.sa: अर्हसे च कपिश्रेष्ठ मया समभिभाषितुम्। यद्यसि प्रेषितस्तेन रामेण विदितात्मना।।5.36.10।।
374.e: "O best of monkeys As you have been sent by Rama, the knower of the self, it is proper for me to converse with you.

374.sa: प्रेषयिष्यति दुर्धर्षो रामो न ह्यपरीक्षितम्। पराक्रममविज्ञाय मत्सकाशं विशेषतः।।5.36.11।।
374.e: "The formidable Rama will not send any one specially to me without testing him or knowing his valour.

374.sa: दिष्ट्या च कुशली रामो धर्मात्मा सत्यसङ्गरः। लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजास्सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः।।5.36.12।।
374.e: "To my luck, righteous Rama who abides in truth and glorious Lakshmana who enhances the joy of Sumitra are keeping well.

374.sa: कुशली यदि काकुत्स्थः किं नु सागरमेखलाम्। महीं दहति कोपेन युगान्ताग्निरिवोत्थितः।।5.36.13।।
374.e: "Indeed if Kakutstha is well wherefore does he not burn the oceangirdled earth in his rage as (the earth is burnt) at the time of dissolution of the era?

374.sa: अथवा शक्तिमन्तौ तौ सुराणामपि निग्रहे। ममैव तु न दुःखानामस्ति मन्ये विपर्ययः।।5.36.14।।
374.e: "Both of them are capable of subduing even the gods. I think the reversal of  my fate is reason for their inaction.

374.sa: कच्चिन्न व्यथितो रामः कच्चिन्न परितप्यते। उत्तराणि च कार्याणि कुरुते पुरुषोत्तमः।।5.36.15।।
374.e: "Is Rama the greatest among men not depressed? Does he not feel helpless? He is (perhaps) taking necessary steps (for my recovery).

374.sa: कच्चिन्न दीन स्सम्भ्रान्तः कार्येषु न च मुह्यति। कच्चित्पुरुषकार्याणि कुरुते नृपतेस्सुतः।।5.36.16।।
374.e: "I suppose prince Rama is not too depressed or perplexed to attend to his work. He will (perhaps) be doing the duties expected of a manly person.

374.sa: द्विविधं त्रिविधोपायमुपायमपि सेवते। विजिगीषुस्सुहृत्कच्चिन्मित्रेषु च परन्तपः।।5.36.17।।
374.e: "Tell me if Rama, scorcher of enemies, desirous of victory is following a two-fold policy (confrontation and conciliation) A tough enemy cannot be defeated by following this method. A three-fold strategy has to be adopted in this case (confrontation, conciliation and creation of dissension among his foes) to be victorious. I hope he is well-disposed to his friends and has a good team!

374.sa: कच्चिन्मित्राणि लभते मित्रैश्चाप्यभिगम्यते। कच्चित्कल्याणमित्त्रश्च मित्रत्त्रैश्चापि पुरस्कृतः।।5.36.18।।
374.e: "I hope he is making new friends, who desire his friendship. Hopefully, Rama is well honoured  by his allies.

374.sa: कच्चिदाशास्ति देवानां प्रसादं पार्थिवात्मजः। कच्चित्पुरुषकारं च दैवं च प्रतिपद्यते।।5.36.19।।
374.e: "Does the prince ever seek the blessings of gods or fall back upon personal effort as well as providence?

374.sa: कच्चिन्न विगतस्नेहः प्रवासान्मयि राघवः। कच्चिन्मां व्यसनादस्मान्मोक्षयिष्यति वानर।।5.36.20।।
374.e: "I hope Rama is not devoid of love towards me by  my separation. O Vanara, hope he will liberate me from this misery.

374.sa: सुखानामुचितो नित्यमसुखानामनौचितः। दुःखमुत्तरमासाद्य कच्चिद्रामो न सीदति।।5.36.21।।
374.e: "I hope Rama who deserves happiness and not suffering has not become depressed now , having experienced a spate of sorrows.

374.sa: कौसल्यायास्तथा कच्चित्सुमित्रायास्तथैव च। अभीक्ष्णं श्रूयते कच्चित्कुशलं भरतस्य च।।5.36.22।।
374.e: "I hope he regularly receives news about the welfare of Kausalya, Sumitra and Bharata.

374.sa: मन्निमित्तेन मानार्हः कच्चिच्छोकेन राघवः। कच्चिन्नान्यमना रामः कच्चिन्मां तारयिष्यति।।5.36.23।।
374.e: "I hope respectable Rama is not too absentminded for being immersed in sorrow on my account. Hope he will save me.

374.sa: कच्चिदक्षौहिणीं भीमां भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः। ध्वजिनीं मन्त्रिभिर्गुप्तां प्रेषयिष्यति मत्कृते।।5.36.24।।
374.e: "Will Bharata, the devoted brother, send his formidable army of one akshavhini protected by ministers for my cause? I trust he will. (Akshauhini  109350 foot soldiers  65610 horse soldiers  21860 elephants soldiers on chariot)

374.sa: वानराधिपतिश्शीमान्सुग्रीवः कच्चिदेष्यति। मत्कृते हरिभिर्वीरैर्वृतो दन्तनखायुधैः।।5.36.25।।
374.e: "I trust that the illustrious Sugriva surrounded  by valiant vanaras who use their teeth and nails as weapons will reach this place.

374.sa: कच्चिच्छ लक्ष्मणश्शूरस्सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः। अस्त्रविच्छरजालेन राक्षसान्विधमिष्यति।।5.36.26।।
374.e: "Hope heroic Lakshmana, enhancer of the joy of Sumitra, who has mastered the use of weapons will blow away the demons through a network of arrows.

374.sa: रौद्रेण कच्चिदस्त्रेण ज्वलता निहतं रणे। द्रक्ष्याम्यल्पेन कालेन रावणं ससुहृज्जनम्।।5.36.27।।
374.e: "Can I hope to see Ravana and his relatives slain in the battle by fiery weapons in a short time?

374.sa: कच्चिन्न तद्धेमसमानवर्णं तस्याननं पद्मसमानगन्धि। मया विना शुष्यति शोकदीनं जलक्षये पद्ममिवातपेन।।5.36.28।।
374.e: "Hope, Rama's moonlike face without me with its golden complexion and lotus fragrance must not have been pale and withered with tears like the lotus in a pond scorched by the heat.

374.sa: धर्मापदेशात्त्यजतश्च राज्यं मां चाप्यरण्यं नयतः पदातिम्। नासीद्व्यथा यस्य न भीर्न शोकः कच्चित्स धैर्यं हृदये करोति।।5.36.29।।
374.e: "Rama has given up sovereignty for the sake of establishing righteousness and led me into the forest on foot.He had not then felt any fear, anxiety or grief at heart.Rama showed patience, instead. Hope he retains them.

374.sa: न चास्य माता न पिता च नान्यः स्नेहाद्विशिष्टोऽस्ति मया समो वा। तावत्त्वहं दूत जिजीविषेयं यावत्प्रवृत्तिं शृणुयां प्रियस्य।।5.36.30।।
374.e: "His love for me is superior to his love for his father, mother or any one else. O messenger, I wish to survive till I hear any  news from my dear lord."

374.sa: इतीव देवी वचनं महार्थं तं वानरेन्द्रं मधुरार्थमुक्त्वा। श्रोतुं पुनस्तस्य वचोऽभिरामं रामार्थयुक्तं विरराम रामा।।5.36.31।।
374.e: The godlike lady, having spoken to the vanara leader in a very meaningful and sweet manner about her beloved Rama, she remained silent, waiting to hear Hanuman's attractive words of description of Rama once again.

374.sa: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः। शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.36.32।।
374.e: Having heard Sita, Hanuman endowed with fearsome power placed his folded hands on his head and said this:

374.sa: न त्वामिहस्थां जानीते रामः कमललोचने। तेन त्वां नानयत्याशु शचीमिव पुरन्दरः।।5.36.33।।
374.e: "O lotuseyed one Rama knows not that you are here. Therefore he has not taken you away immediately as did Indra to rescue his wife Sachi.

374.sa: श्रुत्वैव तु वचो मह्यं क्षिप्रमेष्यति राघवः। चमूं प्रकर्षन्महतीं हर्यृक्षगणसङ्कुलाम्।।5.36.34।।
374.e: "As soon as he hears your words from me, Rama will reach (here), leading a huge army of powerful troops of vanaras and bears.

374.sa: विष्टम्भयित्वा बाणौघैरक्षोभ्यं वरुणालयम्। करिष्यति पुरीं लङ्कां काकुत्स्थः शान्तराक्षसाम्।।5.36.35।।
374.e: "Kakutstha Rama will still the imperturbable abode of Varuna (ocean) by the torrent of his arrows and rid the city of Lanka of all the demons.

374.sa: तत्र यद्यन्तरा मृत्युर्यदि देवास्सहासुराः। स्थास्यन्ति पथि रामस्य स तानपि वधिष्यति।।5.36.36।।
374.e: "Thereafter, whoever comes Rama's way,  be it  gods or demons or even death or any one else he will destroy them.

374.sa: तवादर्शनजेनार्ये शोकेन स परिप्लुतः। न शर्म लभते रामस्सिंहार्दित इव द्विपः।।5.36.37।।
374.e: "O noble lady not being able to see you, Rama is immersed in an ocean of sorrow, he has no solace like an elephant tormented by a lion.

374.sa: मलयेन च विन्ध्येन मेरुणा मन्दरेण च। दर्दुरेण च ते देवि शपे मूलफलेन च।।5.36.38।। यथा सुनयनं वल्गु बिम्बोष्ठं चारु कुण्डलम् । मुखं द्रक्ष्यसि रामस्य पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम्।।5.36.39।।
374.e: "O Sita I swear in the name of mountains like Malaya, Vindhya, Meru, and Dardura (the abodes of monkeys and bears) and  by the roots and fruits as well (which are the food of vanaras). you will soon behold Rama with beautiful eyes, red lips like bimba fruit, lovely earrings and a countenance resembling the full moon.

374.sa: मलयेन च विन्ध्येन मेरुणा मन्दरेण च। दर्दुरेण च ते देवि शपे मूलफलेन च।।5.36.38।। यथा सुनयनं वल्गु बिम्बोष्ठं चारु कुण्डलम् । मुखं द्रक्ष्यसि रामस्य पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम्।।5.36.39।।
374.e: "O Sita I swear in the name of mountains like Malaya, Vindhya, Meru, and Dardura (the abodes of monkeys and bears) and  by the roots and fruits as well (which are the food of vanaras). you will soon behold Rama with beautiful eyes, red lips like bimba fruit, lovely earrings and a countenance resembling the full moon.

374.sa: क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि वैदेहि रामं प्रस्रवणे गिरौ। शतक्रतुमिवासीनं नागराजस्य मूर्धनि।।5.36.40।।
374.e: "O Vaidehi, you will soon see Rama seated on the Prasravana mountain just as Indra (who performed a hundred sacrifices) seated on the back of the king of elephants.

374.sa: न मांसं राघवो भुङक्ते न चाऽपि मधु सेवते। वन्यं सुविहितं नित्यं भक्तमश्नाति पञ्चमम्।।5.36.41।।
374.e: "Rama is not eating meat, nor drinking wine. He takes only the one fifth of a meal (sanctioned for an ascetic) available in the forest.

374.sa: नैव दंशान्न मशकान्न कीटान्न सरीसृपान्। राघवोऽपनयेद्गात्रात्त्वद्गतेनान्तरात्मना।।5.36.42।।
374.e: "Since you left, Rama has been always thinking sincerely of you, no longer drives away flies or mosquitoes nor insects or serpents from his body (his mind entirely fixed on you).

374.sa: नित्यं ध्यानपरो रामो नित्यं शोकपरायणः। नान्यच्चिन्तयते किञ्चित्स तु कामवशं गतः।।5.36.43।।
374.e: "Rama is always lost in thought. He is totally given to grief. Absorbed in love for you, he thinks of none else৷৷

374.sa: अनिद्रस्सततं रामस्सुप्तोऽपि च नरोत्तमः। सीतेति मधुरां वाणीं व्याहरन्प्रतिबुध्यते।।5.36.44।।
374.e: "Rama, the best of men never goes to sleep and even if he drops off to sleep he mutters 'Sita, Sita' in a sweet voice in his sleep.

374.sa: दृष्ट्वा फलं वा पुष्पं वा यद्वाऽन्यत्सुमनोहरम्। बहुशो हा प्रियेत्येवं श्वसंस्त्वामभिभाषते।।5.36.45।।
374.e: "Sighing deeply whenever Rama sees a fruit or a flower or any such delightful thing, he remembers you and calls you out again and again, saying, 'alas, my darling '

374.sa: स देवि नित्यं परितप्यमान स्त्वामेव सीतेत्यभिभाषमाणः। धृतव्रतो राजसुतो महात्मा तवैव लाभाय कृतप्रयत्नः।।5.36.46।।
374.e: "O divine lady prince Rama is ceaselessly suffering. He keeps talking to you in air. The determined Rama is only thinking of your recovery ".

374.sa: सा रामसङ्कीर्तनवीतशोका रामस्य शोकेन समानशोका। शरन्मुखे साम्बुदशेषचन्द्रा निशेव वैदेहसुता बभूव।।5.36.47।।
374.e: Her sorrow was mitigated by references made by Hanuman about Rama.She felt equally sad when she heard about Rama's agony. The princess from Videha appeared like a night at the advent of autumn, with the Moon looking partly muffled by clouds and partly bright. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

375.sa: सीता तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना। हनूमन्तमुवाचेदं धर्मार्थसहितं वचः।।5.37.1।।
375.e: To the righteous words (about Rama's grief) of Hanuman, Sita with a face like the full moon replied.

375.sa: अमृतं विषसंसृष्टं त्वया वानर भाषितम्। यच्च नान्यमना रामो यच्च शोकपरायणः ।।5.37.2।।
375.e: "O vanara you have told me that Rama has his mind always fixed on me, not on others and you have also said that he is sad. It is like offering me poison mixed with nectar.

375.sa: ऐश्वर्ये वा सुविस्तीर्णे व्यसने वा सुदारुणे। रज्ज्वेव पुरुषं बद्ध्वा कृतान्तः परिकर्षति।।5.37.3।।
375.e: "Death snatches a man tied with a cord, whether he is rolling in luxury or sinking in adversity.

375.sa: विधिर्नूनमसंहार्यः प्राणिनां प्लवगोत्तम। सौमित्रिं मां च रामं च व्यसनै: पश्य मोहितान्।।5.37.4।।
375.e: "O best of vanaras surely it is not possible for living beings to overcome destiny. You see how Sri Rama, Saumitri, and my own self are all   afflicted with grief.

375.sa: शोकस्यास्य कदा पारं राघवोऽधिगमिष्यति। प्लवमानः परिश्रान्तो हतनौ स्सागरे यथा।।5.37.5।।
375.e: "When will Raghava reach the shore of this ocean of grief? He is like a man who has suffered a ship wreck, trying to swim?

375.sa: राक्षसानां वधं कृत्वा सूदयित्वा च रावणम्। लङ्कामुन्मूलितां कृत्वा कदा द्रक्ष्यति मां पतिः।।5.37.6।।
375.e: "When will my husband see me after killing the demons including Ravana and uprooting Lanka?

375.sa: स वाच्यस्संत्वरस्वेति यावदेव न पूर्यते। अयं संवत्सरः कालस्तावद्धि मम जीवितम्।।5.37.7।।
375.e: "One year's time has been given (by Ravana) to me.  Rama should be informed to be quick in reaching before the completion of the time limit and that I will survive till then only.

375.sa: वर्तते दशमो मासो द्वौ तु शेषौ प्लवङ्गम। रावणेन नृशंसेन समयो यः कृतो मम।।5.37.8।।
375.e: "O vanara this is the end of the tenth month. Only two more months are left. This is the condition laid by the wicked Ravana in my case.

375.sa: विभीषणेन च भ्रात्रा मम निर्यातनं प्रति। अनुनीतः प्रयत्नेन न च तत्कुरुते मतिम्।।5.37.9।।
375.e: "Vibhisana made efforts to advise Ravana for my restoration. But Ravana has not agreed to that.

375.sa: मम प्रतिप्रदानं हि रावणस्य न रोचते। रावणं मार्गते संख्ये मृत्युः कालवशं गतम्।।5.37.10।।
375.e: "Ravana did not like to return me having fallen into the death trap. Death lies in wait for him in battle.

375.sa: ज्येष्ठा कन्या नला नाम विभीषणसुता कपे। तया ममेदमाख्यातं मात्रा प्रहितया स्वयम्।।5.37.11।।
375.e: "O vanara Nala the eldest daughter of Vibhisana sent by her mother came here personally and reported this to me.

375.sa: असंशयं हरिश्रेष्ठ क्षिप्रं मां प्राप्स्यते पतिः। अन्तरात्मा च मे शुद्धस्तस्मिंश्च बहवो गुणाः।।5.37.12।।
375.e: "O eminent vanara no doubt my lord will soon reach this place. My pure conscience tells me that Rama has many virtues.

375.sa: उत्साहः पौरुषं सत्त्वमानृशंस्यं कृतज्ञता। विक्रमश्च प्रभावश्च सन्ति वानर राघवे।।5.37.13।।
375.e: "O vanara Rama is endowed with perseverance, manliness, prowess, kindness, gratitude, competence and power.

375.sa: चतुर्दशसहस्राणि राक्षसानां जघान यः। जनस्थाने विना भ्रात्रा शत्रुः कस्तस्य नोद्विजेत् ।।5.37.14।।
375.e: "At Janasthana without the help of his brother also he slew fourteen thousand demons. Which enemy will not tremble before him?

375.sa: न स शक्यस्तुलयितुं व्यसनैः पुरुषर्षभः। अहं तस्य प्रभावज्ञा शक्रस्येव पुलोमजा ।।5.37.15।।
375.e: "O bull among men he will not be shaken by calamities. Just as Sachi, the daughter of Puloma knows Indra's might I know Rama's.

375.sa: शरजालांशुमान्शूरः कपे रामदिवाकरः। शत्रुरक्षोमयं तोयमुपशोषं नयिष्यति।।5.37.16।।
375.e: "O monkey the valiant Rama is like the Sungod shoofing a dazzling volley of arrows which will dry up the sea of enemy forces."

375.sa: इति सञ्जल्पमानां तां रामार्थे शोककर्शिताम्। आश्रुसम्पूर्णनयनामुवाच वचनं कपिः।।5.37.17।।
375.e: While Sita, tormented with grief on account of Rama was thus speaking, her eyes filled with tears, the monkey said:

375.sa: श्रुत्वैव तु वचो मह्यं क्षिप्रमेष्यति राघवः। चमूं प्रकर्षन्महतीं हर्यृक्षगणसङ्कुलाम्।।5.37.18।।
375.e: "On hearing me Rama will reach soon with a huge army of vanaras and bears.

375.sa: अथवा मोचयिष्यामि त्वामद्यैव वरानने। अस्माद्धुःखादुपारोह मम पृष्ठमनिन्दिते।।5.37.19।।
375.e: "O beautiful lady, if you please, I shall redeem you today itself from grief. You may ride on my back, O blameless lady.

375.sa: त्वां हि पृष्ठगतां कृत्वा सन्तरिष्यामि सागरम्। शक्तिरस्ति हि मे वोढुं लङ्कामपि सरावणाम् ।।5.37.20।।
375.e: "Placing you on my back I shall cross the ocean. Indeed, I have the capacity to carry the entire city of Lanka along with Ravana.

375.sa: अहं प्रस्रवणस्थाय राघवायाद्य मैथिलि। प्रापयिष्यामि शक्राय हव्यं हुतमिवानलः।।5.37.21।।
375.e: "O Mythili Just as oblations offered to the sacred fire goes to Indra, I shall offer you today to Rama waiting on the Prasravana mountain.

375.sa: द्रक्ष्यस्यद्वैव वैदेहि राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम्। व्यवसायसमायुक्तं विष्णुं दैत्यवधे यथा।।5.37.22।।
375.e: "O Vaidehi you will see Rama and Lakshmana making all out efforts like Lord Visnu to kill the demons.

375.sa: त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहमाश्रमस्थं महाबलम्। पुरन्दरमिवासीनं नागराजस्य मूर्धनि।।5.37.23।।
375.e: Mighty Rama staying in asram ill be enthused to see you seated on my back like Lord Purandara (Indra) seated on the back of the lord of elephants (Airavata)

375.sa: पृष्ठमारोह मे देवि मा विकाङ्क्षस्व शोभने। योगमन्विच्छ रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी।।5.37.24।।
375.e: "O god like lady climb up my back. Do not be reluctant. Join Rama just as Rohini unites with the Moon, O beautiful one

375.sa: कथयन्तीव चन्द्रेण सूर्येण च महार्चिषा। मत्पृष्ठमधिरुह्य त्वं तराकाशमहार्णवौ।।5.37.25।।
375.e: "Climb on my back and cross the ocean through space in the flaming light, conversing with Moon and Sun.

375.sa: न हि मे सम्प्रयातस्य त्वामितो नयतोऽङ्गने। अनुगन्तुं गतिं शक्तास्सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः।।5.37.26।।
375.e: "O beautiful lady it is not possible for all the inhabitants of Lanka together to follow me while I carry you from this place.

375.sa: यथैवाहमिह प्राप्तस्तथैवाहमसंशयः। यास्यामि पश्य वैदेहि त्वामुद्यम्य विहायसम्।।5.37.27।।
375.e: "O Vaidehi just as I reached here I shall beyond doubt take you on my back in the same way across the sky without any difficulty. See.

375.sa: मैथिली तु हरिश्रेष्ठाच्छ्रुत्वा वचनमद्भुतम्। हर्षविस्मितसर्वाङ्गी हनुमन्तमथाब्रवीत्।।5.37.28।।
375.e: When Mythili heard the wonderful proposal from Hanuman, the best of vanaras, she experienced immense joy in every limb of her body and said:

375.sa: हनुमन्दूरमध्वानं कथं मां वोढुमिच्छसि। तदेव खलु ते मन्ये कपित्वं हरियूथप।।5.37.29।।
375.e: "Hanuman how do you intend to carry me to such a distant place? Indeed, it is your monkey nature, I suppose.

375.sa: कथं वाल्पशरीरस्त्वं मामितो नेतुमिच्छसि। सकाशं मानवेन्द्रस्य भर्तुर्मे प्लवगर्षभ।।5.37.30।।
375.e: "O bull among monkeys you have  such a small body. How can you intend to carry me from here to my husband, the lord of men"?

375.sa: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। चिन्तयामास लक्ष्मीवान्नवं परिभवं कृतम्।।5.37.31।।
375.e: On hearing Sita's new belittling statement about him, Hanuman, the illustrious son of the Windgod reflected:

375.sa: न मे जानाति सत्त्वं वा प्रभावं वाऽसितेक्षणा। तस्मात्पश्यतु वैदेही यद्रूपं मम कामतः।।5.37.32।।
375.e: 'Blackeyed Sita is not aware of my strength or my power. Therefore let her see the real (huge) form that I can assume at my free will'.

375.sa: इति सञ्चिन्त्य हनुमांस्तदा प्लवगसत्तमः। दर्शयामास वैदेह्यास्स्वरूपमरिमर्दनः।।5.37.33।।
375.e: Thinking thus, Hanuman, the noble monkey, crusher of enemies, started revealing his real form to Vaidehi.

375.sa: स तस्मात्पादपाद्धीमानाप्लुत्य प्लवगर्षभः। ततो वर्धितुमारेभे सीताप्रत्ययकारणात्।।5.37.34।।
375.e: The wise bull among monkeys, jumped down from the tree and started growing in size in order to instil confidence in Sita.

375.sa: मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशो बभौ दीप्तानलप्रभः। अग्रतो व्यवतस्थे च सीताया वानरोत्तमः।।5.37.35।।
375.e: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras resembling mount Meru or Mandara stood there glowing like blazing fire in front of Sita.

375.sa: हरिः पर्वतसङ्काशस्ताम्रवक्त्रो महाबलः। वज्रदंष्ट्रनखो भीमो वैदेहीमिदमब्रवीत्।।5.37.36।।
375.e: Resembling a mountain in size, with a red face, with teeth and nails strong like  diamond, the vanara in dreadful form said to Vaidehi:

375.sa: सपर्वतवनोद्देशां साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम्। लङ्कामिमां सनाथां वा नयितुं शक्तिरस्ति मे।।5.37.37।।
375.e: "I have the capacity to carry away this entire Lanka uprooted with its mountains, gardens, forts, ramparts and gateways along with the king.

375.sa: तदवस्थाप्यतां बुद्धिरलं देवि विकाङ्क्षया। विशोकं कुरु वैदेहि राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम्।।5.37.38।।
375.e: "O queen it is enough. Give up this unworthy attitude. Be stable. O Vaidehi, rid Lakshmana and Rama of grief".

375.sa: तं दृष्ट्वा भीमसङ्काशमुवाच जनकात्मजा। पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षी मारुतस्यौरसं सुतम्।।5.37.39।।
375.e: Seeing the son of Maruta in dreadful form, the broad lotus petaleyed daughter of Janaka with eyes as large as lotus petals replied :

375.sa: तव सत्त्वं बलं चैव विजानामि महाकपे। वायोरिव गतिं चैव तेजश्चाग्नेरिवाद्भुतम्।।5.37.40।।
375.e: "O great monkey I have understood your strength and power. Your speed is like the Windgod's and your power is astonishing and splendid.

375.sa: प्राकृतोऽन्यः कथं चेमां भूमिमागन्तुमर्हति। उदधेरप्रमेयस्य पारं वानरपुङ्गव।।5.37.41।।
375.e: "O chief of vanaras how could an ordinary person be capable of reaching this land on far off shore of the immeasurable ocean?

375.sa: जानामि गमने शक्तिं नयने चापि ते मम। अवश्यं सम्प्रधार्याशु कार्यसिद्धिर्महात्मनः।।5.37.42।।
375.e: "I know you are capable of carrying me on your journey. I am sure about the quick success of your mission which has been carried out after careful planning.

375.sa: अयुक्तं तु कपिश्रेष्ठ मम गन्तुं त्वयाऽनघ। वायुवेगसवेगस्य वेगो मां मोहयेत्तव।।5.37.43।।
375.e: "O sinless and foremost monkey going with you is not proper for me. Your windlike speed will render me unconscious.

375.sa: अहमाकाशमापन्ना ह्युपर्युपरि सागरम्। प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठाद्भयाद्वेगेव गच्छतः।।5.37.44।।
375.e: "When you fly over the ocean in the sky  speedily I may tumble down from your back by your speed out of fear.

375.sa: पतिता सागरे चाहं तिमिनक्रझषाकुले। भवेयमाशु विवशा यादसामन्नमुत्तमम्।।5.37.45।।
न च शक्ष्ये त्वया सार्धं गन्तुं शत्रुविनाशन। कलत्रवति सन्देहस्त्वय्यपि स्यादसंशयः।।5.37.46।।
375.e: "O destroyer of foes, it is not possible for me to go with you. Further, when you are burdened with a woman you will also fall into danger (because of me), no doubt.

375.sa: ह्रियमाणां तु मां दृष्ट्वा राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः। अनुगच्छेयुरादिष्टा रावणेन दुरात्मना।।5.37.47।।
375.e: "When I am seen (while being carried away) by the demons of fearsome valour they will pursue you, ordered by the wicked Ravana.

375.sa: तैस्त्वं परिवृतश्शूरैश्शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः। भवेस्त्वं संशयं प्राप्तो मया वीर कलत्रवान्।।5.37.48।।
375.e: "O heroic monkey as the warriors armed with spears and maces surround you and attack, your life will be in danger, because of me.

375.sa: सायुधा बहवो व्योम्नि राक्षसास्त्वं निरायुधः। कथं शक्ष्यसि संयातुं मां चैव परिरक्षितुम्।।5.37.49।।
375.e: "The demons are in large number and they will be armed with weapons. You are unarmed. How can you fight and protect me?

375.sa: युध्यमानस्य रक्षोभिस्तव तैः क्रूरकर्मभिः। प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठाद्भयार्ता कपिसत्तम।।5.37.50।।
375.e: "O noble monkey while you are engaged in fighting with those demons of wicked deeds, I may drop down out of fear.

375.sa: अथ रक्षांसि भीमानि महान्ति बलवन्ति च। कथञ्चित्सांपराये त्वां जयेयुः कपिसत्तम।।5.37.51।।
375.e: "O noble monkey the massive, fearsome and powerful demons may defeat you in the fight in any way.

375.sa: अथवा युध्यमानस्य पतेयं विमुखस्य ते। पतितां च गृहीत्वा मां नयेयुः पापराक्षसाः।।5.37.52।।
375.e: "Or else, while you are engaged in fighting and turn your attention the other way I might fall down and the sinful ogres may bear me away.

375.sa: मां वा हरेयुस्त्वद्धस्ताद्विशसेयुरथापि वा। अव्यवस्थौ हि दृश्येते युद्धे जयपराजयौ।।5.37.53।।
375.e: "They may snatch me away from your hands or cut me to pieces. Success or defeat is uncertain in a war.

375.sa: अहं वापि विपद्येयं रक्षोभिरभितर्जिता। त्वत्प्रयत्नो हरिश्रेष्ठ भवेन्निष्फल एव तु।।5.37.54।।
375.e: "In such a case, caught and intimidated by the demons I may die. Then your efforts will be wasted.

375.sa: कामं त्वमसि पर्याप्तो निहन्तुं सर्वराक्षसान्। राघवस्य यशो हीयेत्त्वया शस्तैस्तु राक्षसैः।।5.37.55।।
375.e: "It may be that you can kill  all the demons but by such an act the fame of Rama will be diminished. (He cannot give his strength a trial)

375.sa: अथवाऽदाय रक्षांसि न्यसेयुस्सम्वृते हि माम्। यत्र ते नाभिजानीयुर्हरयो नापि राघवौ।।5.37.56।।
375.e: "Or else, the ogres will carry me  and conceal me in a secret place which the vanaras or Rama and Lakshmana may not know.

375.sa: आरम्भस्तु मदर्थोऽयं ततस्तव निरर्थकः। त्वया हि सह रामस्य महानागमने गुणः।।5.37.57।।
375.e: "All your effort for my sake would be futile. Hence Rama's arrival along with you will be of great benefit.

375.sa: मयि जीवितमायत्तं राघवस्य महात्मनः। भ्रात्रूणां च महाबाहो तव राजकुलस्य च।।5.37.58।।
375.e: "O strongarmed Hanuman your life and the life of the great self Rama, of his brother, and relatives of your king is dependent upon my survival.

375.sa: तौ निराशौ मदर्थं तु शोकसन्तापकर्शितौ। सह सर्वर्क्षहरिभिस्त्यक्ष्यतः प्राणसङ्ग्रहम्।।5.37.59।।
375.e: "Both Rama and Lakshmana who are emaciated with sorrow and suffering on account of me will give up their lives along with vanaras and bears.

375.sa: भर्तुर्भक्तिं पुरस्कृत्य रामादन्यस्य वानर। न स्पृशामि शरीरं तु पुंसो वानरपुङ्गव।।5.37.60।।
375.e: "O chief of vanaras I cherish my devotion towards Rama alone and not touch the body of any other man.

375.sa: यदहं गात्रसंस्पर्शं रावणस्य बलाद्गता। अनीशा किं करिष्यामि विनाथा विवशा सती।।5.37.61।।
375.e: "I had no control over myself. I was helpless and my husband was not present when I had to bear the touch of Ravana's limbs. What can I do?

375.sa: यदि रामो दशग्रीवमिह हत्त्वा सबान्धवम्। मामितो गृह्य गच्छेत तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्।।5.37.62।।
375.e: "It will be proper if Rama comes here, kills Ravana along with all his relations and takes me away.

375.sa: श्रुता हि दृष्टाश्च मया पराक्रमा महात्मनस्तस्य रणावमर्दिनः। न देवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गराक्षसा भवन्ति रामेण समा हि संयुगे।।5.37.63।।
375.e: "I have seen and heard about Rama's conquest of enemies and his valiant deeds in war. Indeed, gods gandharvas, nagas or even demons cannot match him in war.

375.sa: समीक्ष्य तं संयति चित्रकार्मुकम् महाबलं वासवतुल्यविक्रमम्। सलक्ष्मणं को विषहेत राघवं हुताशनं दीप्तमिवानिलेरितम्।।5.37.64।।
375.e: "After seeing Rama who is equal to lord Indra in valour. He is like blazing fire whipped by wind, wielding a wonderful bow, who can withstand the power of strong Rama accompanied by Lakshmana in war?

375.sa: सलक्ष्मणं राघवमाजिमर्दनं दिशागजं मत्तमिव व्यवस्थितम्। सहेत को वानरमुख्य संयुगे युगान्तसूर्यप्रतिमं शरार्चिषम्।।5.37.65।।
375.e: "O chief of vanaras who can withstand Rama accompanied by Lakshmana, the conqueror of enemies? His arrows resemble the rays of the Sun at the time of the deluge, steady like the elephants who support the quarters of the earth.

376.sa: ततस्स कपिशार्दूलस्तेन वाक्येन तोषितः। सीतामुवाच तच्छृत्वा वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः।।5.38.1।।
376.e: Satisfied with the words of Sita, the tiger among monkeys, who was eloquent in speech said:

376.sa: युक्तरूपं त्वया देवि भाषितं शुभदर्शने। सदृशं स्त्रीस्वभावस्य साध्वीनां विनयस्य च।।5.38.2।।
376.e: "O queen O lady of auspicious appearance your words are most appropriate to and characteristic of a modest virtuous woman.

376.sa: स्त्रीत्वं न तु समर्थं हि सागरं व्यतिवर्तितुम्। मामधिष्ठाय विस्तीर्णं शतयोजनमायतम्।।5.38.3।।
376.e: "It may not be possible for a woman to cross on my back the vast ocean stretching over a hundred yojanas. It is not possible for a woman.

376.sa: द्वितीयं कारणं यच्च ब्रवीषि विनयान्विते। रामादन्यस्य नार्हामि संस्पर्शमिति जानकि ।।5.38.4।। एतत्ते सदृशं देवि पत्न्यास्तस्य महात्मनः। का ह्यन्या त्वामृते देवि ब्रूयाद्वचनमीदृशम्।।5.38.5।।
376.e: "O humble lady the second reason given by you, 'I ought not to touch a person other than Rama' is well said and worthy of you, being the wife of the great soul. Who else can speak such words?

376.sa: द्वितीयं कारणं यच्च ब्रवीषि विनयान्विते। रामादन्यस्य नार्हामि संस्पर्शमिति जानकि ।।5.38.4।। एतत्ते सदृशं देवि पत्न्यास्तस्य महात्मनः। का ह्यन्या त्वामृते देवि ब्रूयाद्वचनमीदृशम्।।5.38.5।।
376.e: "O humble lady the second reason given by you, 'I ought not to touch a person other than Rama' is well said and worthy of you, being the wife of the great soul. Who else can speak such words?

376.sa: श्रोष्यते चैव काकुत्स्थ: सर्वं निरवशेषतः। चेष्टितं यत्त्वया देवि भाषितं मम चाग्रतः।।5.38.6।।
376.e: "O queen Kakutstha Rama will hear from me fully all that has been said and done by you in my presence without any omission.

376.sa: कारणैर्बहुभिर्देवि रामप्रियचिकीर्षया। स्नेहप्रस्कन्नमनसा मयैतत्समुदीरितम्।।5.38.7।।
376.e: "O queen my heart is drenched with love for Rama and desires to please him for many reasons. Therefore these words have been spoken by me.

376.sa: लङ्काया दुष्प्रवेशत्वाद्दुस्तरत्वान्महोदधेः। सामर्थ्यादात्मनश्चैव मयैतत्समुदीरितम्।।5.38.8।।
376.e: "Crossing the ocean and entering Lanka are  difficult. But I accomplished it. Hence my proposal.

376.sa: इच्छामि त्वां समानेतुमद्यैव रघुबन्धुना। गुरुस्नेहेन भक्त्या च नान्यथैतदुदाहृतम्।।5.38.9।।
376.e: "I offered to take you today itself out of my love and devotion to Rama with a desire to unite you with him and not with any other intention.

376.sa: यदि नोत्सहसे यातुं मया सार्थमनिन्दिते। अभिज्ञानं प्रयच्छ त्वं जानीयाद्राघवो हि यत्।।5.38.10।।
376.e: "O blameless lady If you wish not to accompany me you may give me a token of identification to let Rama know about my coming here and seeing you".

376.sa: एवमुक्ता हनुमता सीता सुरसुतोपमा। उवाच वचनं मन्दं बाष्पप्रग्रथिताक्षरम्।।5.38.11।। इदं श्रेष्ठमभिज्ञानं ब्रूयास्त्वं तु मम प्रियम्।
376.e: Having heard Hanuman, Sita, a child of god, said these words in a low tone. Choked with tears, 'Carry this token of identity to my dear husband':

376.sa: शैलस्य चित्रकूटस्य पादे पूर्वोत्तरे पुरा।।5.38.12।। तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः प्राज्यमूलफलोदके। तस्मिन्सिद्धाश्रमे देशे मन्दाकिन्या विदूरतः।।5.38.13।। तस्योपवनषण्डेषु नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु। विहृत्य सलिले क्लिन्ना ममाङ्के समुपाविशमः।।5.38.14।।
376.e: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.

376.sa: शैलस्य चित्रकूटस्य पादे पूर्वोत्तरे पुरा।।5.38.12।। तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः प्राज्यमूलफलोदके। तस्मिन्सिद्धाश्रमे देशे मन्दाकिन्या विदूरतः।।5.38.13।। तस्योपवनषण्डेषु नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु। विहृत्य सलिले क्लिन्ना ममाङ्के समुपाविशमः।।5.38.14।।
376.e: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.

376.sa: शैलस्य चित्रकूटस्य पादे पूर्वोत्तरे पुरा।।5.38.12।। तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः प्राज्यमूलफलोदके। तस्मिन्सिद्धाश्रमे देशे मन्दाकिन्या विदूरतः।।5.38.13।। तस्योपवनषण्डेषु नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु। विहृत्य सलिले क्लिन्ना ममाङ्के समुपाविशमः।।5.38.14।।
376.e: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.

376.sa: ततो मांससमायुक्तो वायसः पर्यतुण्डयत्। तमहं लोष्टमुद्यम्य वारयामिस्म वायसम्।।5.38.15।।
376.e: 'Then a crow greedy of flesh began to peck my bossom with its beak. I took a clod of earth and warded him off.

376.sa: दारयन्स च मां काकस्तत्त्रैव परिलीयते। न चाप्युपारमन्मांसाद्भक्षार्थि बलिभोजनः।।5.38.16।।
376.e: 'The crow was an eater of offerings, hungry for food began to peck me again and again for flesh.He did not stop.

376.sa: उत्कर्षन्त्यां च रशनां क्रुद्धायां मयि पक्षिणि। स्रस्यमाने च वसने ततो दृष्टा त्वया ह्यहम्।।5.38.17।।
376.e: 'My upper cloth was slipping. I was trying to pull up my waist string angrily when you saw me.

376.sa: त्वयाऽपहसिता चाहं क्रुद्धा संलज्जिता तदा। भक्षगृध्नेन काकेन दारिता त्वामुपागता।।5.38.18।।
376.e: 'Then you made fun of me, and I became angry. I was abashed. Torn by the voracious bird I sought your shelter.

376.sa: आसीनस्य च ते श्रान्ता पुनरुत्सङ्गमाविशम्। क्रुध्यन्ती च प्रहृष्टेन त्वयाऽहं परिसान्त्विता।।5.38.19।।
376.e: 'Exhausted, I sat on your lap again. Seeing my angry face you pacified me. You were happy (to see me draw close).

376.sa: बाष्पपूर्णमुखी मन्दं चक्षुषी परिमार्जती। लक्षिताऽहं त्वया नाथ वायसेन प्रकोपिता।।5.38.20।।
376.e: 'O lord when I was angered by the crow and my face was filled with tears, you marked me wiping my eyes.

376.sa: परिश्रमात्प्रसुप्ता च राघवाङ्केऽप्यहं चिरम्। पर्यायेण प्रसुप्तश्च ममाङ्के भरताग्रजः।।5.38.21।।
376.e: 'Totally exhausted I slept on your lap for a long time, and in turn you slept on my lap later.

376.sa: स तत्र पुनरेवाथ वायसस्समुपागमत्। ततस्सुप्तप्रबुद्धां मां रामस्याङ्कात्समुत्थिताम्।।5.38.22।। वायसस्सहसागम्य विददार स्तनान्तरे। पुनः पुनरथोत्पत्य विददार स मां भृशम्।।5.38.23।।
376.e: 'The crow came back again and clawed me in the space between my breasts even after I woke up after slumber from Rama's lap. Flying, it tore my bosom again and again.

376.sa: स तत्र पुनरेवाथ वायसस्समुपागमत्। ततस्सुप्तप्रबुद्धां मां रामस्याङ्कात्समुत्थिताम्।।5.38.22।। वायसस्सहसागम्य विददार स्तनान्तरे। पुनः पुनरथोत्पत्य विददार स मां भृशम्।।5.38.23।।
376.e: 'The crow came back again and clawed me in the space between my breasts even after I woke up after slumber from Rama's lap. Flying, it tore my bosom again and again.

376.sa: ततस्समुक्षितो रामो मुक्तैश्शोणितबिन्दुभिः। वायसेन ततस्तेन बलवत्क्लिश्यमानया।।5.38.24।। स मया बोधितश्श्रीमान्सुखसुप्तः परन्तपः।
376.e: 'At the touch of the drops of blood dripping from my body, tormented by seeing me distressed with the dripping blood, you were awakened, you who were an illustrious scorcher of foes.

376.sa: स मां दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्वितुन्नां स्तनयोस्तदा।।5.38.25।। आशीविष इव क्रुद्धश्वसन्वाक्यमभाषत।
376.e: 'O strongarmed Rama, seeing my torn breasts, you became angry like a hissing serpent  and hissing said :

376.sa: केन ते नागनासोरु विक्षतं वै स्तनान्तरम्।।5.38.26।। कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना।
376.e: 'O Sita with a beautiful lap like an elephant trunk by whom is your bosom wounded? Who is sporting with an angry fivehooded snake?

376.sa: वीक्षमाणस्ततस्तं वै वायसं समुदैक्षत।।5.38.27।। नखैस्सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम्।
376.e: 'Then looking around, you saw the crow facing me with sharp, bloodstained claws.

376.sa: पुत्त्रः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः।।5.38.28।। धरान्तरगतश्शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः।
376.e: 'This crow was the best of birds. He was surely Indra's son who had covered a long distance with great speed and his speed was like the Windgod's.

376.sa: ततस्तस्मिन्महाबाहुः कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः।।5.38.29।। वायसे कृतवान्क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वरः।
376.e: 'Then you, the strongarmed and best among the wise, your eyeballs rolling in fury, made up your mind about the cruel crow.

376.sa: स दर्भं संस्तराद्गृह्य ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेण योजयत्।।5.38.30।। स दीप्त इव कालाग्निर्जज्वालाभिमुखो द्विजम्।
376.e: 'Taking out a blade of darbha grass from your mat, you invoked the weapon of Brahma by reciting the mantra. Then you discharged it which blazed like the fire of death and went spearheading towards the crow.

376.sa: स तं प्रदीप्तं चिक्षेप दर्भं तं वायसं प्रति।।5.38.31।। ततस्तं वायसं दर्भस्सोम्बरेऽनुजगाम ह।
376.e: 'Then you threw the burning darbha grass at the crow and it chased him in the sky.

376.sa: अनुसृष्टस्तदा काको जगाम विविधां गतिम्।।5.38.32।। लोककाम इमं लोकं सर्वं वै विचचार ह।
376.e: 'Then that crow flew to many places seeking asylum all over the universe chased by the blade of grass.

376.sa: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तस्सुरैश्च समहर्षिभिः।।5.38.33।। त्रीन्लोकान्सम्परिक्रम्य तमेव शरणं गतः।
376.e: 'Then the crow went round all the three worlds, having been rejected by his father Indra, including all the sages and gods. Refused by all he came back to Rama seeking shelter.

376.sa: स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यश्शरणागतम्।।5.38.34।। वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थ: कृपया पर्यपालयत्।
376.e: 'Seeing the crow fallen on the ground, O Kakutstha, you who are a saviour of those who seek refuge saved him out of compassion, even though he deserved to be killed.

376.sa: परिद्यूनं विषण्णं च स तमायान्तमब्रवीत्।।5.38.35।। मोघं कर्तुं न शक्यं तु ब्राह्ममस्त्रं तदुच्यताम्।
376.e: 'Rama, you saw the crow in pain and despondency who returned to you and said that it is not possible to make Brahma's weapon ineffectual.You may tell now. (what should be done.)

376.sa: हिनस्तु दक्षिणाक्षि त्वच्छर इत्यथ सोऽब्रवीत्।।5.38.36।। ततस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम्। दत्त्वा स दक्षिणं नेत्रं प्राणेभ्यः परिरक्षितः।।5.38.37।।
376.e: 'Then that crow said, 'let my right eye be blinded'. you then hit the right eye of the crow'. Thus the crow offered his right eye and saved himself.

376.sa: हिनस्तु दक्षिणाक्षि त्वच्छर इत्यथ सोऽब्रवीत्।।5.38.36।। ततस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम्। दत्त्वा स दक्षिणं नेत्रं प्राणेभ्यः परिरक्षितः।।5.38.37।।
376.e: 'Then that crow said, 'let my right eye be blinded'. you then hit the right eye of the crow'. Thus the crow offered his right eye and saved himself.

376.sa: स रामाय नमस्कृत्य राज्ञे दशरथाय च। विसृष्टस्तेन वीरेण प्रतिपेदे स्वमालयम्।।5.38.38।।
376.e: 'That crow offered salutations to you Rama and king Dasaratha, thereafter took permission and went to his own dwelling.

376.sa: मत्कृते काकमात्रे तु ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदीरितम्। कस्माद्यो मां हरेत्त्वत्तः क्षमसे तं महीपते।।5.38.39।।
376.e: '(Addressing Rama as though he was present before her, Sita said) 'O lord of the earth for my sake you released the weapon of Brahma on a crow. What makes you excuse him who has abducted me?

376.sa: स कुरुष्व महोत्साहः कृपां मयि नरर्षभ। त्वया नाथवती नाथ ह्यनाथा इव दृश्यते।।5.38.40।।
376.e: 'O bull among men you are so loving to me. I am like an orphan. Be kind to me. She who has found her lord in you stays without a protector.

376.sa: आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मस्तवत्त्त ऐव मया श्रुतः। जानामि त्वां महावीर्यं महोत्साहं महाबलम्।।5.38.41।। अपारपारमक्षोभ्यं गाम्भीर्यात्सागरोपमम्। भर्तारं ससमुद्राया धरण्या वासवोपमम्।।5.38.42।।
376.e: 'O my supreme lord I know you are kind, righteous, valiant, vigroous, mighty. You are boundless, calm and deep like the ocean. You are lord of earth and the seas and compeer of Vasava. I have heard from you that motiveless compassion is the best way to make one righteous.

376.sa: आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मस्तवत्त्त ऐव मया श्रुतः। जानामि त्वां महावीर्यं महोत्साहं महाबलम्।।5.38.41।। अपारपारमक्षोभ्यं गाम्भीर्यात्सागरोपमम्। भर्तारं ससमुद्राया धरण्या वासवोपमम्।।5.38.42।।
376.e: 'O my supreme lord I know you are kind, righteous, valiant, vigroous, mighty. You are boundless, calm and deep like the ocean. You are lord of earth and the seas and compeer of Vasava. I have heard from you that motiveless compassion is the best way to make one righteous.

376.sa: एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठस्सत्यवान्बलवानपि। किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षस्सु न योजयसि राघव।।5.38.43।।
376.e: 'Even though you are an expert in the use of weapons, truthful and strong. (Yet) why are you not using weapons aganst the demons?'

376.sa: न नागा नाऽपि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः। रामस्य समरे वेगं शक्ताः प्रतिसमाधितुं।।5.38.44।।
376.e: (Now Sita turns to Hanuman and says) "In war serpents, gandharvas, demons or Marutas cannot withstand the speed of Rama's arrows and hit back.

376.sa: तस्य वीर्यवतः कश्चिद्यद्यस्ति मयि सम्भ्रमः। किमर्थं न शरैस्तीक्ष्णै: क्षयं नयति राक्षसान्।।5.38.45।।
376.e: "Does Rama have a little anxiety about me? If he has, why does he, a disciplined hero, not  put an end to the demons with his sharp arrows?

376.sa: भ्रातुरादेशमादाय लक्ष्मणो वा परन्तपः। कस्य हेतोर्न मां वीरः परित्राति महाबलः।।5.38.46।।
376.e: "Or, why does the mighty hero, Lakshmana, who is a scorcher of enemies, not come to my rescue taking the orders from his brother?

376.sa: यदि तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ। सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षौ किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः।।5.38.47।।
376.e: "Both Rama and Lakshmana are tigers among men who resemble wind and fire in power and have the unassailability of the gods. Wherefore are they disregarding me?.

376.sa: ममैव दुष्कृतं किञ्चिन्महदस्ति न संशयः। समर्थावपि तौ यन्मां नावेक्षेते परन्तपौ।।5.38.48।।
376.e: "Perhaps I must have committed an atrocious sin. There is no doubt. For although both of them are scorchers of enemies, they deliver me not."

376.sa: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम्। अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.38.49।।
376.e: Hearing the piteous words of Vaidehi and beholding her eyes filled with tears, the Windgod's son, lustrous Hanuman replied thus:.

376.sa: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे। रामे दुःखाभिपन्ने च लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते।।5.38.50।।
376.e: "O godlike lady Rama is not averse to your misery. On my word this is true. Rama is immersed in sorrow. Even Lakshmana wails.

376.sa: कथञ्चिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिदेवितुम्। इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानां द्रक्ष्यस्यन्तमनिन्दिते।।5.38.51।।
376.e: "I could find you with difficulty. This is not the time to wail. O blameless lady take it, your sorrow has come to an end at this moment.

376.sa: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रौ महाबलौ। त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः।।5.38.52।।
376.e: "Both the mighty brothers, tigers among men, are eager to see you. Both the princes will reduce this Lanka  into ashes.

376.sa: हत्त्वा च समरे क्रूरं रावणं सहबान्धवम्। राघवस्त्वां विशालाक्षि नेष्यति स्वां पुरीं प्रति।।5.38.53।।
376.e: "O largeeyed lady cruel Ravana along with his relatives will be killed by Rama in war and Rama will return to his city with you.

376.sa: ब्रूहि यद्राघवो वाच्यो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। सुग्रीवो वापि तेजस्वी हरयोऽपि समागताः।।5.38.54।।
376.e: "Communicate your message to mighty Rama and Lakshamana, to brilliant Sugriva and even the vanaras who gather there.

376.sa: इत्युक्तवति तस्मिंस्तु सीता सुरसुतोपमा। उवाच शोकसन्तप्ता हनुमन्तं प्लवङ्गमम्।।5.38.55।।
376.e: "Hanuman having spoken this way, Sita, resembling a god's daughter, grieving, thus addressed Hanuman:

376.sa: कौसल्या लोकभर्तारं सुषुवे यं मनस्विनी। तं ममार्थे सुखं पृच्छ शिरसा चाभिवादय।।5.38.56।।
376.e: "Bow to Rama and offer salutations on my behalf. Inquiries concerning his welfare should be addressed to Rama, whom virtuous Kausalya bore as a son.

376.sa: स्रजश्च सर्वरत्नानि प्रिया याश्च वराङ्गनाः। ऐश्वर्यं च विशालायां पृथिव्यामपि दुर्लभम्।।5.38.57।। पितरं मातरं चैव सम्मान्याभिप्रसाद्य च। अनुप्रव्रजितो रामं सुमित्रा येन सुप्रजाः।।5.38.58।।
स्रजश्च सर्वरत्नानि प्रिया याश्च वराङ्गनाः। ऐश्वर्यं च विशालायां पृथिव्यामपि दुर्लभम्।।5.38.57।। पितरं मातरं चैव सम्मान्याभिप्रसाद्य च। अनुप्रव्रजितो रामं सुमित्रा येन सुप्रजाः।।5.38.58।।
आनुकूल्येन धर्मात्मा त्यक्त्वा सुखमनुत्तमम्। अनुगच्छति काकुत्स्थं भ्रातरं पालयन्वने।।5.38.59।।
376.e: "Great, righteous Lakshmana had given up his pleasures and followed his brother Rama in his favour into the forest to be able to serve him.

376.sa: सिंहस्कन्धो महाबाहुर्मनस्वी प्रियदर्शिनः। पितृवद्वर्तते रामे मातृवन्मां समाचरन्।।5.38.60।।
376.e: "Lakshmana, who has lionshoulders and strong arms, who is handsome, who takes Rama as his father and treats me as his own mother.

376.sa: ह्रियमाणां तदा वीरो न तु मां वेद लक्ष्मणः। वृद्धोपसेवी लक्ष्मीवान् शक्तो न बहुभाषिता।।5.38.61।। राजपुत्रः प्रियः श्रेष्ठः सदृशः श्वशुरस्य मे।
376.e: "Heroic Lakshmana, did not know while I was borne away. He is prosperous, foremost in serving elders. He is energetic and reserved in his speech like my fatherinlaw. He is a prince dear (to his brother).

376.sa: ममः प्रियतरो नित्यं भ्राता रामस्य लक्ष्मणः।।5.38.62।। नियुक्तो धुरि यस्यां तु तामुद्वहति वीर्यवान्।
376.e: "Rama's brother Lakshmana is always dear to me. Heroic Lakshmana will discharge whichever responsibility is entrusted to him.

376.sa: यं दृष्ट्वा राघवो नैव वृत्तमार्यमनुस्मरेत्।।5.38.63।। स ममार्थाय कुशलं वक्तव्यो वचनान्मम।
376.e: "He is Lakshmana for whose care and support Rama did not miss the noble king Dasaratha (during exile). Convey him my words of enquiry about his wellbeing.

376.sa: मृदुर्नित्यं शुचिर्दक्षः प्रियो रामस्य लक्ष्मणः।।5.38.64।। यथा हि वानरश्रेष्ठ दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत्। त्वमस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तमः।।5.38.65।।
376.e: "Lakshmana is soft, pure, competent and dear to Rama. O great vanara, act in such a manner that Lakshmana can mitigate my suffering. O great monkey, the best of vanaras you are competent in accomplishing this task.

376.sa: मृदुर्नित्यं शुचिर्दक्षः प्रियो रामस्य लक्ष्मणः।।5.38.64।। यथा हि वानरश्रेष्ठ दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत्। त्वमस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तमः।।5.38.65।।
376.e: "Lakshmana is soft, pure, competent and dear to Rama. O great vanara, act in such a manner that Lakshmana can mitigate my suffering. O great monkey, the best of vanaras you are competent in accomplishing this task.

376.sa: राघवस्त्वत्समारम्भान्मयि यत्नपरो भवेत्। इदं ब्रूयाश्च मे नाथं शूरं रामं पुनः पुनः।।5.38.66।।
376.e: "By your efforts alone my husband will try for my release. You may tell these words to my heroic husband, Rama, again and again.

376.sa: जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज। ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवेयं सत्येनाहं ब्रवीमि ते।।5.38.67।।
376.e: "I will hold on to life  only for a month. Beyond, I will not survive. I swear by truth. You may tell this to Rama.

376.sa: रावणेनोपरुद्धां मां निकृत्य पापकर्मणा। त्रातुमर्हसि वीर त्वं पातालादिव कौशिकीम्।।5.38.68।।
376.e: "O heroic Rama just as Kausik was rescued from the underworld it behoves you to deliver me from imprisonment of wicked Ravana".

376.sa: ततो वस्त्रगतं मुक्त्वा दिव्यं चूडामणिं शुभम्। प्रदेयो राघवायेति सीता हनुमते ददौ।।5.38.69।।
376.e: Then Sita took out the exquisite and auspicious Chudamani worn on the head, untied from her clothes and gave it to Hanuman to be presented to Rama.

376.sa: प्रतिगृह्य ततो वीरो मणिरत्नमनुत्तमम्। अङ्गुल्या योजयामास न ह्यस्य प्राभवद्भुजः।।5.38.70।।
376.e: Then Hanuman, taking the extraordinary jewel and placed it on his finger as it was not fitting to his arm.

376.sa: मणिरत्नं कपिवरः प्रतिगृह्याभिवाद्य च। सीतां प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा प्रणतः पार्व्शतः स्थितः।।5.38.71।।
376.e: Having recieved the jewel from Sita and circumambulated her, Hanuman offered salutations to  her and stood by her.

376.sa: हर्षेण महता युक्तः सीतादर्शनजेन सः। हृदयेन गतो रामं शरीरेण तु विष्ठितः।।5.38.72।।
376.e: Hanuman stood there physically, with great joy gazing at Sita, but mentally he was with Rama.

376.sa: मणिवरमुपगृह्य तं महार्हं जनकनृपात्मजया धृतं प्रभावात्। गिरिरिव पवनावधूतमुक्तः सुखितमनाः प्रतिसङ्क्रमं प्रपेदे।।5.38.73।।
376.e: Having received the most precious jewel from the daughter of Janaka, Hanuman prepared to return like a mountain released from the impact of the wind. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

377.sa: मणिं दत्त्वा ततः सीता हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्। अभिज्ञानमभिज्ञातमेतद्रामस्य तत्त्वतः।।5.39.1।।
377.e: Sita gave the jewel to Hanuman and said, "This signet ornament is known to Rama very well".

377.sa: मणिं तु दृष्ट्वा रामो वै त्रयाणां संस्मरिष्यति। वीरो जनन्या मम च राज्ञो दशरथस्य च।।5.39.2।।
377.e: "Seeing this jewel,Rama will recall three of us, my mother, myself and the king Dasaratha" (as this was given by her mother at her marriage.)

377.sa: स भूयस्त्वं समुत्साहे चोदितो हरिसत्तम। अस्मिन्कार्यसमारम्भे प्रचिन्तय यदुत्तरम्।।5.39.3।।
377.e: "Great Hanuman you are enthused now. You may think over the future course of action.

377.sa: त्वमस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तम। हनुमन्यत्नमास्थाय दुःखक्षयकरो भव।।5.39.4।। तस्य चिन्तयतो यत्नो दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत्।
377.e: "O best of monkeys it is your  responsibility to carry out this task. O Hanuman think carefully of that. Take the initiative to reduce my suffering. I am confident that you can do it."

377.sa: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः।।5.39.5।। शिरसा वन्ध्य वैदेहीं गमनायोपचक्रमे।
377.e: Hanuman possessed with fierce valour said to Vaidehi, 'so be it' and bowed his head, and offered salutations before he departed.

377.sa: ज्ञात्वा सम्प्रस्थितं देवी वानरं मारुतात्मजम्।।5.39.6।। बाष्पगद्गदया वाचा मैथिली वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
377.e: The noble lady, Sita, having been fully convinced about Hanuman and realising that he is about to start, her voice was choked with tears. She said these words:

377.sa: कुशलं हनुमन्ब्रूयाः सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।5.39.7।। सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं वृद्धान् सर्वांश्च वानरान्। ब्रूयास्त्वं वानरश्रेष्ठ कुशलं धर्मसंहितम्।।5.39.8।।
377.e: "O Hanuman the great communicate my welfare  to both Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva, his ministers, elderly vanaras in righteous order.

377.sa: कुशलं हनुमन्ब्रूयाः सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।5.39.7।। सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं वृद्धान् सर्वांश्च वानरान्। ब्रूयास्त्वं वानरश्रेष्ठ कुशलं धर्मसंहितम्।।5.39.8।।
377.e: "O Hanuman the great communicate my welfare  to both Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva, his ministers, elderly vanaras in righteous order.

377.sa: यथा स च महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः। अस्माद्धुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि।।5.39.9।।
377.e: "You must pacify the strongarmed Rama in a manner by which he will help me to cross the ocean of grief and rlieve me.

377.sa: जीवन्तीं मां यथा रामः सम्भावयति कीर्तिमान्। तत्तथा हनुमन्वाच्यं वाचा धर्ममवाप्नुहि।।5.39.10।।
377.e: "Let the illustrious Rama take me alive. Help me with your (persuasive) words and you will acquire merit.

377.sa: नित्यमुत्साहयुक्ताश्च वाचश्रुत्वा त्वयेरिताः। वर्धिष्यते दाशरथेः पौरुषं मदवाप्तये।।5.39.11।।
377.e: "On hearing your ever spirited words his manliness to get me back will be charged.

377.sa: मत्सन्देशयुता वाचस्त्वत्तश्श्रुत्वा च राघवः। पराक्रमविधिं वीरो विधिवत्संविधास्यति।।5.39.12।।
सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.39.13।।
377.e: "Having heard Sita's words, Hanuman, son of Maruta, placed his folded palms over his head in reverence and replied:

377.sa: क्षिप्रमेष्यति काकुत्स्थो हार्यृक्षप्रवरैर्वृतः। यस्ते युधि विजित्यारीन्शोकं व्यपनयिष्यति।।5.39.14।।
377.e: "Kakutstha Rama, accompanied by vanaras and bears will reach here soon and conquer the enemies in war and relieve your grief.

377.sa: न हि पश्यामि मर्त्येषु नासुरेषु सुरेषु वा। यस्तस्य क्षिपतो बाणान्स्थातुमुत्सहतेऽग्रतः।।5.39.15।।
377.e: "I do not see any one among humans or demons or even among gods who can face his arrows when released.

377.sa: अप्यर्कमपि पर्जन्यमपि वैवस्वतं यमम्। स हि सोढुं रणे शक्तस्तव हेतोर्विशेषतः।।5.39.16।।
377.e: "Indeed, Rama is capable of conquering even the Sungod, or the raingod or Yama (the son of the Sun) specially for your sake.

377.sa: स हि सागरपर्यन्तां महीं शासितुमीहति। त्वन्निमित्तो हि रामस्य जयो जनकनन्दिनि।।5.39.17।।
377.e: "Rama is fit to rule the entire earth surrounded by the ocean. O delight of Janaka he will succeed in serving your cause."

377.sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्यक्सत्यं सुभाषितम्। जानकी बहुमेनेऽथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्।।5.39.18।।
377.e: On hearing the truthful, proper, pleasing words by Hanuman whom she held in great esteem, Sita said this:

377.sa: ततस्तं प्रस्थितं सीता वीक्षमाणा पुनः पुनः। भर्तृस्नेहान्वितं वाक्यं सौहार्दादनुमानयत्।।5.39.19।।
377.e: Sita again and again looked at Hanuman who was about to start. She made him understand her words conveying her love for Rama.

377.sa: यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिन्दम। कस्मिंश्चित्संवृते देशे विश्रान्तःश्वो गमिष्यसि।।5.39.20।।
377.e: "O destroyer of enemies if you think of halting for a day you may do so in a solitary location and leave tomorrow.

377.sa: मम चेदल्पभाग्याया सान्निध्यात्तव वानर। अस्य शोकस्य महतो मुहूर्तं मोक्षणं भवेत्।।5.39.21।।
377.e: "Your presence will relieve me of my suffering, if you stay here for a while.

377.sa: गते हि हरिशार्दूल पुनरागमनाय तु। प्राणानामपि सन्देहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः।।5.39.22।।
377.e: "O tiger among vanaras if you leave this place to come again, my life will be uncertain, (if your coming is uncertain). There is no doubt about it.

377.sa: तवादर्शनजः शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत्। दुःखाद्धुःखपरामृष्टां दीपयन्निव वानर।।5.39.23।।
377.e: "My agony would be increased further by not seeing you. It would be inflamming my agony and I would be even more pained.

377.sa: अयं च वीर सन्देहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः। सुमहांस्त्वत्सहायेषु हर्यृक्षेषु हरीश्वरः।।5.39.24।।
377.e: "O heroic chief of vanaras I am doubtful as to whether vanaras and bears can extend help?

377.sa: कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं तरिष्यन्ति महोदधिम्। तानि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ।।5.39.25।।
377.e: "How can the army of vanaras and bears, for that matter, princes Rama and Lakshmana negotiate the ocean, which is difficult to cross?

377.sa: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्यास्य लङ्घने। शक्तिस्स्याद्वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा।।5.39.26।।
377.e: "It is only three beings who have the capacity to leap over this ocean. Garuda, or you or the Windgod.

377.sa: तदस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे। किं पश्यसि समाधानं त्वं हि कार्यविदां वरः।।5.39.27।।
377.e: "What means do you, being the foremost hero among the three who are capable performing this difficult task, foresee?

377.sa: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने। पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते फलोदयः।।5.39.28।।
377.e: "O slayer of enemy heroes if you alone can accomplish this task the fame of doing this will be yours.

377.sa: बलैस्समग्रैर्यदि मां रावणं जित्य संयुगे। विजयी स्वपुरं यायात्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्।।5.39.29।।
377.e: "It would be worthy of Rama if he with his entire army emerges victorious over Ravana in a battle and takes me to his city.

377.sa: शरैस्तु सङ्कुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः। मां नयेद्यदि काकुत्स्थः तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्।।5.39.30।।
377.e: "If Kakutstha (Rama), slayer of the enemy army fills the entire Lanka with his arrows and takes me, then his action will be worthy of him.

377.sa: तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः। भवेदाहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय।।5.39.31।।
377.e: "You may make arrangement in such a manner that, that great self, the hero in war makes his victorious march which is worthy of him."

377.sa: तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं प्रश्रितं हेतुसंहितम्। निशम्य हनुमान्शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.39.32।।
377.e: Having heard the meaningful, courteous and logical words of Sita, Hanuman replied:

377.sa: देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः। सुग्रीवस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः।।5.39.33।।
377.e: "O Devi the lord of monkeys, Sugriva heads the army of vanaras and bears. He is richly endowed with satvaguna and is determined to accomplish your cause and free you from sorrow.

377.sa: स वानरसहस्राणां कोटीभिरभिसंवृतः। क्षिप्रमेष्यति वैदेहि राक्षसानां निबर्हणः।।5.39.34।।
377.e: "O Vaidehi Sugriva will reach this place with thousands of crores of vanaras very soon and would kill all the ogres.

377.sa: तस्य विक्रमसम्पन्नास्सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः। मनस्सङ्कल्पसम्पाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः।।5.39.35।।
377.e: "Valiant, virtuous and powerful vanaras who can leap with the speed of mind are awaiting orders (of Sugriva).

377.sa: येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक्सज्जते गतिः। न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः।।5.39.36।।
377.e: "Their course cannot be impeded either upward, or downward or right or left. They  are indeed very brilliant and would never fail in any task.

377.sa: असकृत्तैर्महोत्साहैस्ससागरधराधरा। प्रदक्षिणीकृता भूमिर्वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः।।5.39.37।।
377.e: "They have often circumambulated the earth including its oceans and mountains through the aerial path with great enthusiasm.

377.sa: मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः। मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसन्निधौ।।5.39.38।।
377.e: "The vanaras under Sugriva who move in the forest are more powerful than me or equal to me. None is inferior to me.

377.sa: अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः। न हि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः।।5.39.39।।
377.e: "If I have managed to come here, why not the other powerful ones? The superior leaders are not sent (as messengers). Only ordinary ones like me are.

377.sa: तदलं परितापेन देवि शोको व्यपैतु ते। एकोत्पातेन ते लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः।।5.39.40।।
377.e: "O noble lady therefore, give up your agony. Enough of your lamentation. The monkey troops will reach this place in one stride.

377.sa: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ। त्वत्सकाशं महासत्त्वौ नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः।।5.39.41।।
377.e: "Both the valiant Rama and Lakshmana, lions among men, looking brilliant like Sun and Moon will come to you riding on my back.

377.sa: ततो वीरौ नरवरौ सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। आगम्य नगरीं लङ्कां सायकैर्विधमिष्यतः।।5.39.42।।
377.e: "Both the heroes, Rama and Lakshmana will come and blow up the city of Lanka with their unfailing arrows.

377.sa: सगणं रावणं हत्त्वा राघवो रघुनन्दनः। त्वामादाय वरारोहे स्वपुरीं प्रतियास्यति।।5.39.43।।
377.e: "O beautiful lady Raghava, the delight of the Raghu race would kill Ravana and his kins and return with you to his city৷৷

377.sa: तदाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते भव त्वं कालकाङ्क्षिणी। नचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसे रामं प्रज्वलन्तमिवानलम्।।5.39.44।।
377.e: "Therefore, count the days and rest assured. Let it be auspicious to you. You will shortly see Rama burning like fire.

377.sa: निहते राक्षसेन्द्रेऽस्मिन्सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे। त्वं समेष्वसि रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी।।5.39.45।।
377.e: "When Ravana is slain, with his sons, ministers and kith and kin, you will reunite with Rama as Rohini unites with the Moon.

377.sa: क्षिप्रं त्वं देवि शोकस्य पारं यास्यसि मैथिलि। रावणं चैव रामेण निहतं द्रक्ष्यसेऽचिरात्।।5.39.46।।
377.e: "O queen Mythili you come to the end of your sorrow and will soon see Ravana killed by Rama".

377.sa: एवमाश्वास्य वैदेहीं हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। गमनाय मतिं कृत्वा वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत्।।5.39.47।।
377.e: Having thus consoled Vaidehi, Hanuman, son of the Windgod resolved to depart. Once again he spoke to Vadehi:

377.sa: तमरिघ्नं कृतात्मानं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्। लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणिं लङ्काद्वारमुपागतम्।।5.39.48।।
377.e: "Very soon you would see the slayer of foes, who is an accomplished wielder of the bow (Rama) along with Lakshmana at the entrance of Lanka.

377.sa: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान्वीरान्सिम्हशार्दूलविक्रमान्। वानरान्वारणेन्द्राभान्क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि सङ्गतान्।।5.39.49।।
377.e: "You will soon see heroic vanaras whose weapons are their teeth, who are like lion and tiger in their valour. They are (mighty) like wellbred elephants.

377.sa: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानां लङ्कामलयसानुषु। नर्दतां कपिमुख्यानामार्ये यूधान्यनेकशः।।5.39.50।।
377.e: "O respectable lady you would see many troops of vanara chiefs who resemble clouds hovering on the mountain peaks of Lankaroaring.

377.sa: स तु मर्मणि घोरेण ताडितो मन्मथेषुणा। न शर्म लभते रामस्सिंहार्धित इव द्विपः।।5.39.51।।
377.e: "Rama is tormented by the dreadful arrows of the god of love pierced into vitals, like an elephant hit by a lion. He has no happiness in life.

377.sa: मा रुदो देवि शोकेन माभूत्ते मनसोऽप्रियम्। शचीव पत्या शक्रेण भर्त्रा नाथवती ह्यसि।।5.39.52।।
377.e: "O devi weep no more.Entertain no unpleasant thoughts.You have a great husband, just as Sachi has her lord Indra.

377.sa: रामाद्विशिष्टः कोऽन्योऽस्ति कश्चित्सौमित्रिणा समः। अग्निमारुतकल्पौ तौ भ्रातरौ तव संश्रयौ।।5.39.53।।
377.e: "Who is superior to Rama? Who is equal to Lakshmana? Both the brothers are like Fire and Wind. They are your refuge.

377.sa: नास्मिंश्चिरं वत्स्यसि देवि देशे रक्षोगणैरध्युषितेऽतिरौद्रे। न ते चिरादामगमनं प्रियस्य क्षमस्व मत्सङ्गमकालमात्रम्।।5.39.54।।
377.e: "O noble lady You will not stay longer in this country, which is a strong hold of hosts of demons and a dreadful place It will not be very long before you unite with your beloved. Pray, have  patience till then. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

378.sa: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य वायुसूनोर्महात्मनः। उवाचात्महितं वाक्यं सीता सुरसुतोपमा।।5.40.1।।
378.e: Sita who was like the daughter of the gods heard the son of the Windgod for her benefit and replied:

378.sa: त्वां दृष्ट्वा प्रियवक्तारं सम्प्रहृष्यामि वानरः। अर्धसञ्जातसस्येव वृष्टिं प्राप्य वसुन्धरा।।5.40.2।।
378.e: "O vanara just as the earth feels happy when the half grown crops receive rain, I feel happy after seeing you. You have been speaking pleasing words

378.sa: यथा तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं गात्रैश्शोकाभिकर्शितैः। संस्पृशेयं सकामाहं तथा कुरु दयां मयि।।5.40.3।।
378.e: "Be kind to me and act in such a manner that I may embrace my lord passionately with my body emaciated with grief.

378.sa: अभिज्ञानं च रामस्य दद्या हरिगणोत्तम। क्षिप्तामिषीकां काकस्य कोपादेकाक्षिशातनीम्।।5.40.4।।
378.e: "O best leader of vanaras remind Rama about the incident of the release of a blade of grass in anger blinding one of the eyes of the crow narrated to you.

378.sa: मनश्शिलायास्तिलको गण्डपार्श्वे निवेशितः। त्वया प्रणष्टे तिलके तं किल स्मर्तुमर्हसि।।5.40.5।।
378.e: '(Further remind him), 'When my tilaka mark was erased, you painted tilaka with a stone (manassita pigment) nearby. O Rama you should remember that (incident).

378.sa: स वीर्यवान्कथं सीतां हृतां समनुमन्यसे। वसन्तीं रक्षसां मध्ये महेन्द्रवरुणोपमः।।5.40.6।।
378.e: 'Rama you are like Indra and Varuna in valiance. How are you tolerating Sita seized, dwelling among the demons?

378.sa: एष चूडामणिर्दिव्यो मया सुपरिरक्षितः। एतं दृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्यामि व्यसने त्वामिवानघ।।5.40.7।।
378.e: "O sinless Rama this wonderful Chudamani of mine has been carefully safeguarded. Seeing this is like seeing you when I am in distress.

378.sa: एष निर्यातितश्श्रीमान्मया ते वारिसम्भवः। अतः परं न शक्ष्यामि जीवितुं शोकलालसा।।5.40.8।।
378.e: "I am sending you this (Chudamani) born of the sea. O glorious Rama and now engrossed in grief it is not possible for me to live.

378.sa: असह्यानि च दुःखानि वाचश्च हृदयच्छिदः। राक्षसीनां सुघोराणां त्वत्कृते मर्षयाम्यहम्।।5.40.9।।
378.e: "I am tolerating this unbearable grief, and the words of the dreadful ogresses piercing my heart. Only for you.

378.sa: धारयिष्यामि मासं तु जीवितं शत्रुसूदन। ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीविष्ये त्वया हीना नृपात्मज।।5.40.10।।
378.e: "O subduer of enemies O prince I will hold on to life only for a month. I will not survive beyond a month in your absence.

378.sa: घोरो राक्षसराजोऽयं दृष्टिश्च न सुखा मयि। त्वां च श्रुत्वा विपद्यन्तं न जीवेयमहं क्षणम्।।5.40.11।।
378.e: "The demon king is frightful. He looks at me with immoral (lusty) eyes. I do not wish to live even for a moment after hearing about the adversities (you have faced)."

378.sa: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रु भाषितम्। अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.40.12।।
378.e: Hearing the words of Sita who was weeping piteously, brilliant Hanuman said this:

378.sa: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे। रामे दुःखाभिभूते तु लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते।।5.40.13।।
378.e: "O irreproachable lady I swear by you that Rama has grown averse to everything out of grief of separation from you. When Rama is in grief even Lakshmana gets immersed in sorrow.

378.sa: कथञ्चिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम्। इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि भामिनि।।5.40.14।।
378.e: "O beautiful lady somehow I could meet you. This is not the time to worry about. You will see the end of suffering at this very moment.

378.sa: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रावरिन्दमौ। त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः।।5.40.15।।
378.e: "Both the princes are tigers among men and crushers of enemies. They are determined to see you, and will reduce Lanka to ashes.

378.sa: हत्त्वा च समरे क्रूरं रावणं सहबान्धवम्। राघवौ त्वां विशालाक्षि स्वां पुरीं प्रापयिष्यतः।।5.40.16।।
378.e: "O largeeyed lady Killing in war the vile Ravana, the demon king and all his relatives, Rama would take you back to his own city৷৷

378.sa: यत्तु रामो विजानीयादभिज्ञानमनिन्दिते। प्रीतिसञ्जननं तस्य भूयस्त्वं दातुमर्हसि।।5.40.17।।
378.e: "O unimpeachable lady give one more identification which would make him more happy".

378.sa: साब्रवीद्दत्तमेवेति मयाभिज्ञानमुत्तमम्। एतदेव हि रामस्य दृष्ट्वा मत्केशभूषणम्।।5.40.18।। श्रद्धेयं हनुमन्वाक्यं तव वीर भविष्यति।
378.e: "I have already given the best identification. When you hand this jewel used on my hair to him,  he will believe what you tell him".

378.sa: स तं मणिवरं गृह्य श्रीमान्प्लवगसत्तमः।।5.40.19।। प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीं गमनायोपचक्रमे।
378.e: The illustrious vanara held the ornament, prostrated to Sita and prepared to depart.

378.sa: तमुत्पातकृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य हरिपुङ्गवम्।।5.40.20।। वर्धमानं महावेगमुवाच जनकात्मजा। अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा।।5.40.21।।
378.e: Seeing Hanuman eager to leap, enlarging his body quickly, she appeared pitiable with her face filled with tears and throat choked.

378.sa: तमुत्पातकृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य हरिपुङ्गवम्।।5.40.20।। वर्धमानं महावेगमुवाच जनकात्मजा। अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा।।5.40.21।।
378.e: Seeing Hanuman eager to leap, enlarging his body quickly, she appeared pitiable with her face filled with tears and throat choked.

378.sa: हनुमन्सिंहसङ्काशौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं सर्वान् ब्रूयाह्यनामयम्।।5.40.22।।
378.e: "O Hanuman to the lionlike brothers Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva  including his ministers and to every one convey my good wishes.

378.sa: यथा च स महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः। अस्माद्दु:खाम्बुसम्रोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि।।5.40.23।।
378.e: "You should make efforts in such a manner that the mightyarmed Rama will help me in crossing the cean of sorrow.

378.sa: इमं च तीव्रं मम शोकवेगं रक्षोभिरेभिः परिभर्त्सनं च। ब्रूयास्तु रामस्य गतस्समीपम् शिवश्च तेऽध्वाऽस्तु हरिप्रवीर।।5.40.24।।
378.e: "Foremost vanara tell Rama about my intense grief as well as the threats of the demons. May your journey be happy.

378.sa: स राजपुत्र्य्राप्रतिवेदितार्थः कपिः कृतार्थः परिहृष्टचेताः। अल्पावशेषं प्रसमीक्ष्य कार्यं दिशं ह्युदीचीं मनसा जगाम।।5.40.25।।
378.e: Hanuman understood the message of princess Sita and felt delighted at heart at his accomplishment. Considering the small task yet to be accomplished he reached the northern shore mentally (He thought of Rama who waited in Kishkinda which is in the northern direction). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

379.sa: स च वाग्भिः प्रशस्ताभिर्गमिष्यन्पूजितस्तया। तस्माद्देशादपक्रम्य चिन्तयामास वानरः।।5.41.1।।
379.e: Having been honoured and praised by Sita's words, Hanuman prepared to depart from Sita's presence.

379.sa: अल्पशेषमिदं कार्यं दृष्टेयमसितेक्षणा। त्रीनुपायानतिक्रम्य चतुर्थ: इह विद्यते।।5.41.2।।
न साम रक्षस्सु गुणाय कल्पते न दानमर्थोपचितेषु युज्यते। न भेदसाध्या बलदर्पिता जनाः पराक्रमस्त्वेव ममेह रोचते।।5.41.3।।
379.e: 'With demons, negotiation is of no use. They are wealthy, they need no gifts. Proud of their stregth, the demons will not yield to dissension. I think only by using power it can be done.

379.sa: न चास्य कार्यस्य पराक्रमादृते विनिश्चयः कश्चिदिहोपपद्यते। हतप्रवीरा हि रणे हि राक्षसाः कथञ्चिदीयुर्यदिहाद्य मार्दवम्।।5.41.4।।
379.e: 'Other than power, there is no way to accomplish the task of ascertaining their strength. If I slay a few strong ogres somehow they may soften a little and yield.

379.sa: कार्ये कर्मणि निर्दिष्टे यो बहून्यपि साधयेत्। पूर्वकार्याविरोधेन स कार्यं कर्तुमर्हति।।5.41.5।।
379.e: 'He, who can perform tasks in addition to the objective accomplished without affecting it, is really worthy.

379.sa: न ह्येकस्साधको हेतुस्स्वल्पस्यापीह कर्मणः। यो ह्यर्थं बहुधा वेद स समर्थोऽर्थसाधने।।5.41.6।।
379.e: 'There are ways more than one even to perform a small work. And the capable know it.

379.sa: इहैव तावत्कृतनिश्चयो ह्यहं यदि व्रजेयं प्लवगेश्वरालयम्। परात्मसम्मर्दविशेषतत्त्ववित्ततः कृतं स्यान्मम भर्तृशासनम्।।5.41.7।।
379.e: 'If I ascertain the difference in the strength of enemies and vanaras in war here itself and return to Kishkinda, the abode of vanaras, then I would have executed the orders of my lord properly.

379.sa: कथं नु खल्वद्य भवेत्सुखागतं प्रसह्य युद्धं मम राक्षसैः सह। तथैव खल्वात्मबलं च सारवत्सम्मानयेन्मां च रणे दशाननः।।5.41.8।।
379.e: 'How can I have enduring war with the ogres today? How will my visit to this place end in happy return? Only in a combat this tenheaded Ravana will guage his strength and mine

379.sa: ततस्समासाद्य रणे दशाननं समन्त्रिवर्गं सबलप्रयायिनम्। हृदि स्थितं तस्य मतं बलं च वै सुखेन मत्त्वाऽहमितः पुनर्व्रजे।।5.41.9।।
379.e: 'I can return happily only after I gauge the tenheaded Ravana's army in war, his strength, his companions including the ministers and his mind.

379.sa: इदमस्य नृशंसस्य नन्दनोपममुत्तमम्। वनं नेत्रमनःकान्तं नानाद्रुमलतायुतम्।।5.41.10।।
379.e: 'This Ashoka garden of Ravana filled with different kinds of trees and creepers is a feast to the eyes and mind. It is an excellent garden like the Nandana  garden of Indra.

379.sa: इदं विध्वंसयिष्यामि शुष्कं वनमिवानलः। अस्मिन्भग्ने ततः कोपं करिष्यति दशाननः।।5.41.11।।
379.e: 'I will devastate this garden, just as fire destroys a dried up forest. This will enrage Ravana.

379.sa: ततो महत्साश्वमहारथद्विपं बलं समादेक्ष्यति राक्षसाधिपः। त्रिशूलकालायसपट्टिसायुधं ततो महद्युद्धमिदं भविष्यति।।5.41.12।।
379.e: 'Then the demon king will order the horses, chariots and elephants and army equipped with tridents and spears to march against me. A great war will take place.

379.sa: अहं तु तैः संयति चण्डविक्रमै स्समेत्य रक्षोभिरसह्य विक्रमः। निहत्य तद्रावणचोदितं बलं सुखं गमिष्यामि कपीश्वरालयम्।।5.41.13।।
379.e: 'I will fight with the ogres sent by Ravana, endowed with fierce strength and irresistible valour. After destroying their army I will go to the abode of vanaras happily'.

379.sa: ततो मारुतवत्कृद्धो मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः। ऊरुवेगेन महता द्रुमान्क्षेप्तुमथारभत्।।5.41.14।।
379.e: Furious Maruti endowed with fierce valour started uprooting the trees with the speed sprung from his thighs like the Windgod.

379.sa: ततस्तु हनुमान्वीरो बभञ्ज प्रमदावनम्। मत्तद्विजसमाघुष्टं नानाद्रुमलतायुतम्।।5.41.15।।
379.e: Then Hanuman felled a variety of trees and vines inhabited by intoxicated birds in the beautiful garden meant for womenfolk.

379.sa: तद्वनं मथितैर्वृक्षैर्भिन्नैश्च सलिलाशयैः। चूर्णितैः पर्वताग्रैश्च बभूवाप्रियदर्शनम्।।5.41.16।।
379.e: That garden looked ugly with uprooted trees, breached ponds and powdered mountain peaks.

379.sa: नानाशकुन्तविरुतैः प्रभिन्नैस्सलिलाशयैः। ताम्रैः किसलयैः क्लान्तै: क्लान्तद्रुमलतायुतम्।।5.41.17।। न बभौ तद्वनं तत्र दावानलहतं यथा। व्याकुलावरणा रेजुर्विह्वला इव ता लताः।।5.41.18।।
379.e: Vines and trees wilted, birds shrieking, the embankments of ponds destroyed, its tender coppery red shoots withered, the garden looked as though it is burnt by forest fire and the climbers looked like women shivering in fear with their robes disarrayed.

379.sa: नानाशकुन्तविरुतैः प्रभिन्नैस्सलिलाशयैः। ताम्रैः किसलयैः क्लान्तै: क्लान्तद्रुमलतायुतम्।।5.41.17।। न बभौ तद्वनं तत्र दावानलहतं यथा। व्याकुलावरणा रेजुर्विह्वला इव ता लताः।।5.41.18।।
379.e: Vines and trees wilted, birds shrieking, the embankments of ponds destroyed, its tender coppery red shoots withered, the garden looked as though it is burnt by forest fire and the climbers looked like women shivering in fear with their robes disarrayed.

379.sa: लतागृहैश्चित्रगृहैश्च नाशितैर्महोरगैर्व्यालमृगैश्च निर्धुतैः। शिलागृहैरुन्मथितैस्तथा गृहैः प्रणष्टरूपं तदभून्महद्वनम्।।5.41.19।।
379.e: The great garden lay disfigured, with the arbours and the picture galleries ruined, huge serpents and wild animals scattered, with stone houses and sheds destroyed.

379.sa: सा विह्वलाऽशोकलताप्रताना वनस्थली शोकलताप्रताना। जाता दशास्यप्रमदावनस्य कपेर्बलाद्धि प्रमदावनस्य।।5.41.20।।
379.e: The pleasuregarden of Ravana appeared as though it was spreading the creepers of sorrow, since it was totally destroyed by the monkey who had set out to protect a woman. प्रमदावनस्य  of the pleasure garden, प्रमदाअवनस्य of the hero who came to protect a lady.

379.sa: स तस्य कृत्वार्थपतेर्महाकपिर्महद्व्यलीकं मनसो महात्मनः। युयुत्सुरेको बहुभिर्महाबलैश्शिया ज्वलंस्तोरणमास्थितः कपिः।।5.41.21।।
379.e: The great vanara having perpetrated mischief, rousing anger in the mind of the great lord of wealth, stood at the exit doorway ready to combat singlehanded with many warriors in that  mighty army blazing in glory. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
